tei:div.tei:p: "$ (511)༄༅// bsnyen sgrub kyi 'grel bshad yid bzhin nor bu bzhugs/

(512)༄༅// bsnyen sgrub 'grel bshad yid bzhin gyi nor bu gsal ba zhes bya ba/ chos kyi rje grub thob chen po'i zhabs kyi pad+mo la gus par phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// yon tan kun gyi gter gyur pa// 'gro ba kun gyi skyabs gcig po// bla ma mchog la gus phyag 'tshal// rnam pa kun ldan stong nyid sna tshogs yum// rnam dag bde chen rgya mtsho lhun gyis grub// zag med bde chen ye shes bskyed pa'i yum// bcom ldan 'das ma'i zhabs la gus pas 'dud// 'khor ba'i gnas skabs bzhi po bcom nas rgyal ba yi// sku bzhi mngon du byed pa'i thabs mchog bsnyen sgrub gsum// nyi zla stobs drag bcom nas dbu ma rgyas mdzad pa'i// dpal ldan lam mchog de la gus par phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje btsun mo bla ma dam pa nyid// rjes su bzung nas gnang ba'i gzhung nyid la// chos rje nyid kyi gsung dang lung gis brgyan// cung zad gsal ba tsam du dbye bar bya// (513)zab rgyas gzhung gi dgongs pa 'grol ba'i blo// bdag 'dra byis par gyur pas ga la mchi// 'on kyang chos rje yun rings bsten gyur cing*// gsung rgyun 'dzin la brtson pas 'bad pa dang*// mched po gong mas rje yi gsung bgros la// yi ge mdzad pa rnams kyi gung bsos shing*// zhal shes gdams pa'i gnad kyis legs brgyan nas// rang gzhan kun la phan phyir yi ger bkod// de yang rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dam pa dpal ldan o rgyan pa zhes mtshan yongs su grags pa de nyid kyis/ o rgyan sprul pa'i zhing du byon pa'i dus su/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nyid kyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ dga' bzhi'i 'gros kyis dbang bzhi mngon sum du bskur nas/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes bde ba chen por lus can thams cad la gdod ma nyid nas gnas na'ang*/

'pho ba'i bag chags dus gsum gyi rang bzhin gyi dbang gis/ blo bur gyi dri mas bsgribs te ma rig pa las/ der las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis kha (514)bsgyur nas/ thar bar dka' ba'i 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor yang dang yang du zo chu'i 'khyud mo bzhin du 'khor ba'i sems can 'dul ba'i slad du ste/ de yang gdul bya dbang po rnon po brtson 'grus rab tu gyur pa rnams skye ba 'di nyid la rdo rje 'chang gi sar 'gro ba'i lam thams cad kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa rdo rje gsum gyi bsnyen bsgrub ces bya ba 'di gnang bar gda'/ de la 'dir zab mo gnad kyi gsung bgros rnams 'bri bas chos bdag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis gnang bar zhu zhing*/ gnang nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ de la rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ gdams pa 'di la rdo rje bzhi ru byas na'ang 'ong 'od pa yin te/ chos 'di byung ba'i dus su sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje rnam pa gsum zhes bya ba byung bas/ ye shes rdo rje shugs las bstan pa yin gsungs/ de dang mthun par/ bde mchog bsdus rgyud las kyang*/ dag byed sdig pa 'joms byed yin/ sangs rgyas de nyid sgrub pa ni// sngags bzlas pa dang bsam gtan dang*// bde bas kyang ni 'grub par 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// de lus rtsa dag par byed pa sku rdo rje'i bsnyen pa la/ dang po skyil krung gsum gyis nyams su len pa byed de/ steng skyil krung gis steng gi rlung bcing*/ 'og gi skyil krung gis 'og gi rlung bcing*/ bar skyil krung gis bar gyi rlung bcing pa ste/ de yang*/ stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis rtsa yi bcud// ces pas/ khams drug dang ldan pa'i skyes bu chen po'i lus 'di la/ rtsa stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis chags pa ste/ de yang dang por ma'i mngal du khu khrag dang*/ kun gzhi rnam (515)par shes pa bde bas byin gyis brlabs pa'o// de nas zla ba gcig na snying ga'i dbus su shin tu phra ba'i rtsa bcu thams pa rlung bcu'i rten du phyur pa rnams chags shing*/

de nas brtsams te zhag re la rtsa nyis brgya nyis brgya 'phel bas zla ba bcu gnyis na stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis 'gyu'o// de nas zhag re la rtsa gnyis gnyis rtsa skams pas/ lo brgya song ba dang rtsa rnams skams te zad do// dus kyi 'chi ltas 'byung ba ni/ des tshe zad pa'o// rtsa de rnams kyi gtso bo ni/ steng 'og tu drug ste/ de'ang lte ba'i steng du g.yon du la la nā dang*/ g.yas su rā sa nā dang*/ dbus su a wa dhū ti'o// lte ba'i 'og tu/ g.yon du dri chen dang*/ g.yas su dri chu dang*/ dbus su khu ba 'bab pa rnams so// rtsa stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis po rnams bcud ni/ rlung dang kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa dang*/ byang chub kyi sems rnams te/ de yang*/ snga ma snga ma ni brten pa yin la/ phyi ma phyi ma ni rten yin no// nam mkha'i khams su gza' rnams brtan par bcing*// zhes pas/ rtsa rlung byang chub kyi/ sems dang gsum po 'di rnams ma chings pa las/ 'dzag sgo chen po bzhi zhes pa de'ang*/ 'khor ba'i gnas skabs bzhi zhes pa de rnams 'byung pas/ de rnams bsnyen sgrub gsum gyi rim par bcings pas/ 'khor ba 'di las thar pa ste/ de'ang gang du 'ching na/ mun pa dang snang ba'i nam mkhar rnal 'byor gnyis kyis 'ching ste/ ji ltar 'ching na/ brtan pa ste yul la 'jug pa med par bcing ngo*// (516)gza' rnams ces pa ni/ dbang po'i sgo rnams te/ dri ma med pa'i 'od las// 'dir bshangs pa'i bu ga ni zla ba'o// gci pa'i bu ga ni nyi ma'o// khu ba'i bu ga ni sgra gcan no// mig g.yas ba'i bu ga ni mig dmar ro// mig g.yon pa'i bu ga ni gza' lhag pa'o// sna g.yas pa'i bu ga ni phur bu'o// sna g.yon pa'i bu ga ni pa sangs so// rna ba g.yon pa'i bu ga ni spen pa'o// rna ba g.yon pa'i bu ga ni 'jug rings so// zhes so// gza' de rnams gyen du 'ching ba ste/ 'di ltar nyams su len pa'i gang zag ni/

bla med kyi dkyil 'khor chen po dbang thob pa/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi dang*/ sbom po la sogs pa'i ltung ba dang bral ba/ dge ba bcu la spyod pa/ 'du 'dzi g.yeng ba mtha' dag spangs shing*/ rdzas su ma chags shing gtong ba'i ngang tshul can/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi longs spyod la ma zhen pa// 'dzag pa'i bde ba la ltos pa med par/ thun mong gi dngos grub la ltos pa med par thar pa kho na don du gnyer pa/ mngon par rtogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin ji srid rgyud la ma brtan gyi bar du sbed shes pa la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pas/ gtsug lags khang gi dkor la sogs pa'i log 'tsho slangs pa'i yo byad thams cad tshogs par bya ste/ sgrub pa'i gnas ni/ thag dang gzhi mtho bas sa rlabs chung ba/ phyogs thams cad zhal bas bkag pa/ grub na sgrub khang sum rim mam/ yang na gsal dkar ma rtogs pa'i bu ga rta rnga shong ba tsam yang med pa/ sgo 'khyog rim pa gsum mam/ 'dzul sgo can la mun pa legs par bsgrubs nas/ (517)bde ba'i stan la 'dug ste/ skyabs 'gro dang sems skyed tsam bya ste/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor sgom pa/ gzhan gyi spros pa thams cad lings kyis dor nas/ g.yas kyi rtsa la srog dbab pa'i dus su bsgom par bya ba ste/ sa la sogs pa bsdud pa'i rim pa yin pa'i dus khyad par can du 'gyur pa yin gsungs/ g.yon pa'i rtsa la srog dbab pa'i dus ma yin te nam mkha' la sogs pa bskyed pa'i rim pas blta ba'i phyir ro// bsgom pa'i tshul ni 'di ltar bya ste/ rkang pa rdo rje skyil krung dam/ skyil krung bya ste pus mos la dbab cing tshigs pa drang por bsrang*/ lag pa rdo rje khu tshur byas nas brla rtsa gnon pa ste/ de skad du/ dus 'khor las kyang*/ khu tshur brla yi steng du rdo rje'i gdan la gnas pa rgyal ba'i bdag po rigs kyi phyag rgyar 'gyur/ zhes bshad/ de'i dpung pa phyir gdeng*/ ltag pa drang por bsrang*/

mgrin pa cung zad sgrubs/ ol mdud mnan/ lce nang du dril la rkan la sbyar/ kha sna cung zad nyer tsam bya/ rna bar hring btang*/ mig gnyis rdo rje gtsug tor gyi lta stongs gyen du bltas te/ mig mi 'dzum par had de bzhag /dus 'khor las kyang*/ so sor bsdud pa lus la yul dang yul can bcu po rnams ni rab tu 'jug pa med pa'o// zhes pa ste/ gzugs la sogs pa'i yul lnga la mig gi rnam par shes pa la sogs pa lnga 'jug med pa ste/ stong gzugs kyi yul rnams la rab tu 'jug pa med pa'o// gsang 'dus las kyang*/ dngos po med pa sgom pa min// bsgom pa bya ba sgom pa min// de ltar (518)dngos dang dngos med pas// sgom pa dmigs su med pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de yang dang por khams gso ba'i ched du ha cang mtho ba ma yin pas mig phyed bkab tsam blta bar bya ste/ dbang mdor bstan pa las kyang*/ bkab dang ma bkab mig dag gis// stong par 'di ni rjes brtags min// rmi lam bzhin du gzugs mthong 'gyur// rtag tu gzugs de bsgom par bya// zhes gsungs so// dmigs pa gang yang mi 'dzin pa sgom 'dod kyi rtog pa thams cad phyir bsnyil te/ tha na nyams myong dang rtags kyi 'dod pa tsam yang mi byed par/ blo rten gang la yang mi 'cha'// blo gang du'ang mi 'dzin par/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang du ma yengs tsam du bzhag cing*/ sgo lnga bcud la bor bas rtsa ba dang yan lag gi rlung dang rnam rtog nang du zin nas rnam par mi rtog pa skye zhing*/ du ba la sogs pa'i stong gzugs mthong bar 'gyur te/ rtsa rgyud las kyang*/ bsam pa thams cad yongs spangs te// nyi ma gcig tu rnam par brtag /gal te rtags ni ma byung na// de tshe nga yi rdzun tshig yin// zhes gsungs so// sangs rgyas rnams nges pa'i don la rdzun mi gsung zhing de ltar bsgoms na nges par zhag gcig la rtags mthong ba yin no// 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub sgrub pa la ni/

nyin mtshan gcig gi rtags mthong ba med do// de'i phyir lam rin po che 'di nyid khyad par du 'phags shing*/ ngo mtshar bar nges shes bskyed par bya'o// de yang mun par bsgom pa'i tshe/ mun snang de nyid la mig gi dbang po rang rig pas khyad par bkod nas// (519)khams kyis chun na kha zas kyi dus ma yin pa thams cad du 'bral ba med par bsgom/ zas kyi dus su'ang sems kyi 'jog lugs dang lta stangs ma shor bar bya/ thun mtshams su cung zad dgos pa yang*/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i gang snang la/ mig gi dbang po dang shes pas khyab par bkod nas/ ma yengs pa'i ngang nas mi sgom par rtsol med du 'jog pa yin/ ma yengs la rtsol ba med pa'i gnad de la/ rig pa legs pa chun na nyams myong btsan thabs su skye/ de'i gnad ma zin na/ 'phral du ngas dungs kyi 'jur drag gi rtsol ba bskyed kyang*/ sgom gyi sna sun pa'i skyon du song dogs yod cing*/ de lta na stong nyid rgyud la mi skye/ stong nyid ma skyes na du ba la sogs pa'i rtags rnams mthong ba mi srid do// de ltar mtshan mo gnyis kyi dus su yang*/ tsog pu'am/ ltag tu cung zad gnyis pa tsam mam/ yang mdun tu mnyams pa tsam la gnyid log pas/ thog mar gnyid mi phebs pa'am/ sgom 'phro la gnyid du 'gro ba 'ong ste/ yun du goms pa bzhin/ gnyid nang du'ang rtags rnams 'char bas/ nyin mtshan khyad mi 'ong ste/ snying rus dang brtson 'grus kyis chun na/ lhag par mtshan mo'i nyams gsal bar 'byung ngo*// rtags rnams ni/ du ba dang*/ smig rgyu dang*/ me khyer dang*/ mar me dang*/ mkha' snang la sogs pa dang*/ nyin mo'i rnal 'byor gyis nyin rtags rnams 'byung ba ste/ dus 'khor las kyang*/ nam mkhar kun nas zhen pa'i sems dang mig ni mi 'dzum rdo rje'i lam du rab tu zhugs pa yis// stong pa las ni du ba smig rgyu rab gsal (520)dri ma med pa'i mkha' snang nyid dang mar me dang*// 'bar ba dang ni zla ba nyi ma rdo rje rnams dang mchog gi cha dang thig le mthong bar 'gyur// de yi dbus su sangs rgyas gzugs ni yul dang rnam par bral ba du ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku// nam mkha' chu 'dzin bral ba dag ni rnal 'byor pa yis bgrad pa'i mig gis lta bya ste// re khā nag po dri med 'od zer 'phro ba dus kyi rtsa la 'thong bar 'gyur gyi bar du'o// de la kun mkhyen gzugs ni chu la nyi ma lta bur gos pa med par kha dog sna tshogs te// rnam pa kun ldan rang sems yul dang rnam par bral ba dag go sems ni gzhan pa min pa nyid// ces gsungs so// de la nyin mo'i rnal 'byor sgom pa ni// snga dro dang phyi dro nyi ma dang ser bu la rgyab phyogs par bya zhing*/

nyin gung la bsgom par bya ba ma yin te/ gzhan du na mig rab tu 'gyur pas so// stan bde ba la sngar gyi byed bcings kyis/ dbang po yul so so la 'jug pa sems rtse gcig tu bsdus nas/ nam mkha' rgya chen po mthong pa'i sar/ ri bo'i rtse'am/ thang chen po'am/ khang thog gam/ phyed g.yabs kyi 'og gam/ nam mkha' dwangs pa sprin med pa la sgom zhing*/ cung zad goms nas sprin yod pa'am/ nam mkha' gar yod du goms nas/ nyin mo'i rtags drug mthong bar 'gyur te/ 'di stong nyams kyi ting nge 'dzin rtsal ma rdzogs kyi bar du sgom par bya ba yin no// de ltar bsgoms pas rlung stod du 'tshangs pa la sogs pa byung na/ steng gi nyes pa'i skyon rnams 'dag par byed pa dang*/ rlung so so'i gnad kyis mal du byed pa la/ 'og gi skyil krung ni/ rgya mtsho'i steng du rtsa gsum yan lag (521)bsdams/ shes pas na/ rgya mtsho ni lto ba/ gting ni 'og sgo/ rtsa gsum ni dri chen dang dri chu dang khu ba 'bab pa rnams so// yan lag ni rkang pa gnyis te/ de rnams bsdam par bya'o// lus bsam gtan gyi chos lngar ldan par byas la/ 'og sgo gnyis thad kar bsdams/ nywa bzhi bsgrim/ rkang pa'i sor mo bskum/ sgal tshig dgyed bya/ lto ba man chad cha cha nas bsgrims la/ rnam snang gi lta stangs mthur la blta zhing*/ steng rlung klod/ 'og rlung bzung la// mi rtog pa la gnag pa ste/ de ltar bsgoms pas steng gi skyon rnams 'og gis sel la/ steng gi skyil krung bsgoms pas/ 'og gi skyon rnams sel ba ste/ dper na snod kyi chu dang*/ ril ba zhabs chags can lta bur 'og bcings pas steng rlung rang shugs gyis zin la/ steng bcings pas 'og rlung rang shugs kyis zin pa yin/ 'di gnyis kyis rlung ma lus pa dbang du 'du ba ste/ skyil krung gnyis bsgom pa'i dgos pa yin/ de la/ nyi khri chig stong drug brgya rlung gi tshogs// steng 'og rtsa yis bcings pas zin par 'gyur// sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i bdag nyid kyi// 'byung ba'i rlung rnams nang du 'gags par byed// ces pa ste/

nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'i rlung ni/ g.yon zla ba dang g.yas nyi ma dang*/ dbus sgra gcan gyis 'jug pas 'pho chung dang*// 'pho chen du rgyu ba ste/ 'pho chung re re la dbugs sum brgya bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad dang*/ bzhi cha gsum du 'gyur zhing*/ 'pho chen re re la dbugs stong phrag bdun brgya bzhi bcu rtsa gsum dang bzhi cha gsum rgyu'o// ye shes kyi rlung ni/ 'pho chen gyi mtshams su/ lnga bcu rtsa drug /bzhi cha sna bug gnyis nas mnyam du 'bab pa ste/ bsdoms pas zhag gcig la drug brgya (522)dang bdun cu rtsa lnga'o// de ltar zhag gcig la/ las dang ye shes kyis rlung bsdams pas nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'i rlung rgyu ba yin no// de rnams bsdoms pas lo brgya la/ las kyi rlung lo dgu bcu rtsa drug dang*/ zla ba phyed dang bcu gcig tu 'gyur/ ye shes kyi rlung lo gsum dang zla ba phyed dang gsum du 'gyur pa'o// de yang sa dang chu dang me dang rlung dang nam mkha'i rang bzhin gyi rlung rnams ni g.yas nas 'pho chung gi rim pas bsdud pa'i rim pa dang*/ g.yon nas bskyed pa'i rim pas rgyu ba ni 'byung ba'i rlung rnams so// nang du 'gag pa ni/ a wa dhu tir 'jug pa'o// dus kyi 'khor lo las kyang*/ sa ni chu la rab tu 'jug cing chu yang 'bar byed la ste rtsa bar byed pa rlung la'o// rlung ni stong pa la stong pa nges pa mtshan ma rnam pa bcu ru 'gyur zhing mtshan ma ni// rnam pa thams cad pa ru 'gyur te mi zad mchog gi bde ba gzhom du med pa ye shes sku// ye shes las ni rdzu 'phrul dngos grub tu 'gyur mi bdag skyes bu rnams kyis skye ba 'di nyid la'o// zhes gsungs/ de'ang steng 'og gi skyil krung gis bcings pas/ rlung sems thams cad 'chings shing zin par 'gyur pas/ de nas steng 'og gi gegs sel dang*/ dbab bzung la sogs pa thams cad kyis gnang 'di la yod pa'o// dbang mdor bstan las kyang*/

zla ba nyi ma'i rtsa 'gags nas// dri chen dri chu'i rtsa 'gags go /zhes gsungs so// steng 'og gnyis bcud pa'i rjes la/ bar gyi skyil krung ma shes na// rlung nang du rgyun par mi gnas pas/ lus bsam gtan gyi chos lnga dang ldan par bya/ rlung kha sbyor du bzung la/ (523)de nas bar rlung stobs bskyed nas/ steng 'og gnyis glod de/ pus mo cung zad dgye bar bya/ lto ba phyir cher bskyed de ji tsam thub tshad du bzung la nan tan du bsgoms pas steng 'og gnyis kyi gegs thams cad sel bar byed/ khyad par pho ba'i me drod bskyed cing*/ zas dang khams kyi dwangs snyigs 'byed/ rtsa rlung gi skyon thams cad 'dag cing*/ yon tan mtha' dag 'di las skyes pa yin// rlung sems thams cad rtsa gnas dang stod smad dang*/ lag sor la sogs par khrims shing 'drongs pa'i gnad thams cad 'di la yod pas/ mgo mjug thams cad 'di gnad zin pa gal che gsung*/ spyir lus sems rlung gsum gcig la gcig bsten pa yin pas lus gnad 'chugs na rlung gi gnad kyang 'chugs pa ste/ de la skyil krung legs par 'cha' shes na/ thur sel gsang ba'i rlung 'chings/ lag pa rdo rje khu tshur rla mgor bzhag /lto ba drang por bsrang bas me dang mnyams gnas kyi rlung 'chings/ dpung pa rgod gshog ltar rgyangs// brang dgye dgur ma song bar srog 'dzin chu'i rlung 'chings/ ko kos ol mdud non rta mchog gong sgron pa lta bus gyen rgyu me'i rlung 'chings/ lus spyi'i lus gnad ma 'chugs pas/ khyab byed nam mkha'i rlung 'chings/ de ltar 'byung ba lnga'i bdag nyid rtsa ba'i rlung lnga 'chings pas// yan lag gi rlung lnga yang rang shugs kyi 'chings te/ der rlung bcu dhū tir chud nas/ kun+dha byang chub kyi sems dang*/ don dam byang chub kyi sems 'chings pas rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin skye ba'o// rlung ro rkyang gnyis (ེ 524)nas phyir shor bas/

spyir byang chub kyi sems 'dzag /khyad par rnam rtog sna tshogs skye ste/ rnam rtog gi byed po ro rkyang gnyis yin/ de gnyis kyi me tog mig gnyis yin pas lta stangs rnam pa gsum bya ste/ de'ang rlung sems gyen la bud cing rgod na thur du blta/ thig le thur la bud cing phying na gyen la blta/ rmugs shing dwangs snyigs ma phyed pa dang*/ dran med lta bu'i skyon la thad dkar blta ba'o// 'byung ba'i rlung rnams nang du 'gags par byed// ces pa ste/ de lta bus byed bcings kyis/ rlung bcu ka dbang du byas nas rtsa rlung thig le gsum ka 'ching ba ste/ de'i rtags ni/ bde gsal mi rtog ting 'dzin las su rung*/ zhes pas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi byed pa rang gnas su bcings pas khams byang chub kyi sems cung zad brten pa'i stobs kyis bde ba skye ba dang*/ sha ba'i mig la sogs pa'i rnam par shes ba du ba la sogs pa'i stong gzugs la 'jug pa ni gsal ba'o// mig la sogs pa'i rnam shes phyi rol gyi gzugs la sogs pa'i yul la 'jug pa med pa ni mi rtog pa'o// de'i dus su lus sems la skyo ba dang dub pa med pa bde gsal mi rtogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin rtsol mang du 'byung ba'i las su rung ba'o// 'byung ba'i rlung rnams nang du zin pa yis// rtags dang yon tan rnams ni rim bzhin 'char// zhes pa ste/ dngos 'dzin ni 'byung ba lnga'i rlung yin la/ a wa dhū ti'i nang du rim par zin pa'i rtags ni/ rnal 'byor gyi stobs kyis yid kyis ma brtags pa'i gzugs sgyu ma'am/ gzhon nu mas pra bab pa'i snang ba lta bu stong ba'i ngang du mthong bar 'gyur/ de (525)yang sa rlung zin pas du ba lta bu dang*/ chu rlung zin pas smig rgyu lta bu dang*/ me rlung zin pas srin bu me khyer lta bu dang*/ rlung gi rlung zin pas mar me 'bar ba'am/ mar me'i 'od lta bu ste/ mtshan mo'i rtags bzhi dang*/

nam mkha'i rlung 'gags pas sprin med pa'i nam mkha' lta bu zhes/ gsang 'dus las/ mtshan rtags lnga ru yang gsungs so// nyin mo'i rtags ni me 'bar ba lta bu dang*/ zla ba lta bu snang ba dang*/ nyi ma lta bu dang*/ rdo rje'am sgra gcan ste nag ling ling pa dang*/ glog lta bu dang*/ shin tu phra ba'i thig le sna tshogs pa dang*/ thig le'i dbus su gnas pa'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i bdag nyid can sangs rgyas kyi sku mthong ba ste/ nyin mo'i rtags drug go /de rnams ni nges pa'i rtags yin la ma nges pa'i bum pa dang snam bu dang ri 'di la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ de thams cad lus nyams sems nyams rmi nyams gsum gyi rtags te/ ngos 'dzin legs par shes dgos gsungs/ de ltar rtags kyi snang ba sna tshogs te/ rig pa gsal stong gi ngo bor ngo sprod dgos te/ gzhi lam 'bras bu'i chos thams cad rang gi sems kyi snang ba las logs su med cing*/ rtags snang ma 'gags par gsal ba de sems kyi mtshan nyid yin la/ de'i rang bzhin stong par gnas pas snang stong dbyer med pa'i ngo bo// chu nang gi zla ba'am/ me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bu ngo sprad gsung*/ grub pa'i tshad ni tshig gi mchog ster ba ste/ me dang gdon la sogs pa zhi bar gyur cig /ces pas/ zhi ba la sogs pa'o// (526)dbang po lnga dang yul lnga dbyer med du shes pas/ lha sku lnga shar ba ni/ bsam gtan gyi rtags bcu'o// yan lag ni/ shes rab dang*/ rtog pa dang*/ dpyod pa dang*/ dga' ba dang*/ g.yo med bde ba ste bsam gtan gyi yan lag lnga'o// dus 'khor las kyang*/ bsam gtan dag kyang shes rab rtog dang dpyod pa dga' dang g.yo med bde ba rtse cig sems pa'o// zhes gsungs/ de la shes rab ces pa ni/ stong pa nyid kyi gzugs de nyid la lta ba'o// rtog pa ces pa sems kyis dngos po 'dzin pa'o// dpyod pa zhes pa ni 'dzin pa'i dngos po de'i don nges pa'o// dga' ba zhes pa gzugs de nyid la chags pa'o// g.yo med bde ba zhes pa gzugs la sogs pa dang lhan cig tu byed pa'o// sor sdud kyi stong gzugs mthong ba/

bsam gtan gyi gzugs la sems kyis kun nas mkhyud de brtan par byed pa yin te/ yon tan ni/ mngon shes lnga 'char ba la sogs pa'o// de ltar so sor sdud dang bsam gtan gyi sku rdo rje'i bsnyen pa song nas/ ༈ spyi don gnyis pa ngag rlung dag par byed pa gsung rdo rje'i sgrub pa ni/ zla ba dang nyi ma'i dbye bas rlung bcu'am/ rtsa ba dang yan lag gi ces pa'i rlung bcu/ 'byung 'jug gnas gsum gyi rim pa la gnas shing*/ de yang rtsa rnams khyim dang*/ thig le longs spyod dang*/ rlung bdag po'i tshul du gnas/ rig pa byang chub kyi sems rten de rnams la brten pa'i tshul du gnas te/ rten de rnams gnas na tshe gnas la/ mi gnas na tshe mi gnas pas/ srog yin la/ rtsol ba ni/ steng 'og (527)bar gsum rlung 'dzin pa dang*/ lam du byed pa/ sgom pa khrid kyi rim pa bzhin du byas pas/ rlung bcu dhū tir tshud nas 'khor lo drug gi thig le'i nang du 'gro 'ong byed pa ste/ de'i rtags ni rmongs rengs la sogs pa'i las chen po rnams sgrub par nus so// lag tu blang ba'i rim pa ni/ stong pa nyid kyi gzugs mthong zhing brtan pa dang*/ srog rtsol gyi man ngag bsgom par bya ste/ de yang*/ steng srog rtsol gyi rlung*/ bar kha sbyor gyi rlung zhes bya ba ste/ de la dang po rlung gi lam btsal zhing lam du byed tshul gyi khyad par ni lus ltar bskyed/ stan bde ba la lus bsam gtan gyi chos lnga dang ldan pa'am/ tsog phur sgom thag bcug pa'am/ lus gnad legs par bcas pa'i gnad 'thems par byas de/ bla ma la gsol ba btab nas/ rlung ro legs par phyung ste/ nam mkha'i rlung gi 'dzin stangs/ rlung 'jug pa dang 'byung ba tshor rig med pa lta bur/ 'jam zhing dal la cha mnyam pas yun ring du bzung*/ 'di la rlung nang du 'jug pa oṃ/ bar du gnas pa hūm̐/ phyir dbyungs pa āḥ de ltar 'byung 'jug gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyi ngo bor gnas pas/

de nyid sna'i sgo nas/ rang rang gi sor tshad dang ldan pa'i 'gro 'ong la rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang nas sems 'dzin pa yin gsungs/ de bzhin du/ rlung gi rlung drag la ring bar bzung la bsgom/ me'i rlung drag thung du sbud sbud bzung la bsgom/ chu'i rlung so bar cung zad bsdoms pa'i bar nas bzhur pa'i sir sgra dang bcas pas bzung la bsgom/ sa'i rlung nam mkha'i rlung (528)las cung zad drag par tshor tsam du dal bus bzung la bsgom te/ dmigs skor lnga po 'di dag gis rlung gi mal rnyed nas/ gegs dang nyes pa mi 'byung ba yin gsung*/ rlung spyi khyab du yang*/ lus gnad skyil krung dang*/ sgom thag bcug pa gnyis las/ so so'i lus kyi gnas dang*/ dus kyi gnad 'thems pa gal che gsungs/ de nas 'og thur sel gyi rlung gis 'byung ba rims brtsegs bsgoms pa ni/ nam mkha' rlung me chu dang sa rnams kyis/ thur du bsdams pas de la gsal bar blta/ zhes pas/ 'og thur sel bsten pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ lus bsam gtan gyi chos lnga dang ldan par bya/ lag pa gnyis pus mo la dgab/ dang po 'byung ba so so'i 'dzin stangs kyis/ srog rlung bzung ste lte 'og tu phul nas/ thur bsdam par bya'o// dmigs pa ni/ e yig sngon po yongs su gyur pa las nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor sngon po gru gsum shin tu yangs pa es mtshan pa blos mkhyud tshad shin tu dwangs pa gcig bsgom/ nam mkha'i rlung zin pa'i rtags ni/ lus med pa lta bu'i stong nyams bzang po 'char ro// chos 'byung de'i steng du yaṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po gzhu'i dbyibs can/ g.yo ba'i ba dan gyis mtshan pa yang zhing g.yo ba bsgom/ rlung zin pa'i rtags ni/ mgo zi ba dang*/ g.ya' za ba sogs pa 'byung*/ yang rlung gi dkyil 'khor de'i steng du/ raṃ yig las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po reg bya shin tu tsha ba raṃ gyis mtshan pa bsgom/

rlung zin pa'i rtags ni/ (529)drod sngar bas che ba dang lus tsha ba la sogs pa 'byung*/ yang me'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du paṃ yig las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po reg bya ba sil ba/ bum pa bzhi yis mtshan par bsgom/ rlung zin pa'i rtags ni/ grang ba dang 'dar ba la sogs pa 'ong ngo*// yang chu'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ laṃ yig las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi pa reg bya lci ba rdo rje rgya gram bzhis mtshan pa bsgom/ rlung zin pa'i rtags ni/ lus dang shes pa lci ba dang 'gro snying mi 'dod pa la sogs pa 'ong*/ 'di rnams bsgom pa'i dus su 'og rlung la gnad du bsnun pa'i rlung sbyor yin no// de yang snga ma snga ma la brtan pa la ma thob bar/ phyi ma phyi ma sgom pa ma yin zhing*/ khyad par du 'byung ba'i rim pa rnams la nan tan tu bsgoms pas/ de rnams kyis rlung dbang du 'dus te/ sa'i yon tan gyis lus mnga' zhing*/ ting nge 'dzin las ldang mi nus pa dang*/ lus la dri zhim po 'byung ba'o// chu'i yon tan lus snum pa dang*/ gnyen zhing khog gsal ba'o// me'i yon tan lus la bde drod 'bar ba dang*/ bkrag mdangs dang gzi mdangs 'bar ba dang*/ ro bro ba sna tshogs pa'o// rlung gi yon tan lus yang ba dang*/ reg bya 'jam pa dang rtse zhing 'gyogs pa la sogs 'ong*/ nam mkha'i yon tan thams cad go 'byed pa ste/ sngar gyi thams cad dang cha mthun pa'i yon tan 'byung ba'o// de dag brtan nas gdan gsal gdab pa ni/ rlung sbyor 'byung ba rim brtsegs dang mtshungs pas/ nam mkha'i dkyil (530)'khor gyi steng du/ ye shes kyi gdan ljang khu zlum po'i dbyibs can bsgom par bya'o// de nas rlung dang chu dang me dang sa'i dkyil 'khor rnams kyi rim pa bzhin/ sgra gcan dang*/ nyi ma dang*/ zla ba dang*/ dus me rnams kyi gdan gyi dbyibs can/ reg bya dang 'byung ba rim brtsegs dang mthun par bsgom mo// 'di'i skabs su/

res 'ga' thur sel gyi gnad kyis nad gzhi 'don pa dang*/ de 'byongs nas 'phongs kyis chu 'thung ba la sogs pa'i rlung sbyor yang 'byon par 'dug ste/ zhal las shes par bya'o// 'og thur ser gyi rlung yang zhes bya/ me rlung zhes kyang bya ste/ 'og nas 'jug pa'i rlung sbyor ro// de nas steng srog rtsol gyi rlung sbyor gyis sa bon yig 'bru bskyed pa ni/ sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i bdag nyid kyis/ yig 'bru'i rgyu ba ā li kā li'i rlung*/ yi ge gsum gyis steng du bsdams pa las/ shes pa/ srog rlung gis 'byung ba so so'i kha dog can gyi yig 'bru sgom pa yin la/ de yang yi ge gsum gyi rang bzhin gyis lam du byed pa ste/ 'byung 'jug gnas gsum oṃ yig dang*/ hūm̐ yig dang*/ āḥyig rnams su shes par bya zhing*/ yang g.yon zla ba ste/ ā li khu ba'i chos can thabs kyi rang bzhin dang*/ g.yas nyi ma ste/ kā li dhūl gyi chos can shes rab kyi rang bzhin dang*/ ye shes kyi rlung gi thabs shes dbyer med par dbu mar 'dren pa yin no// dus 'khor las kyang*/ zla ba nyi ma la yang a rtsegs ka rtsegs rdo rje dang bcas me long lnga rnams kyis// shes so// srog dang thur sel gang zin lam du 'gro ba ni// steng (531)'gags pa las 'og tu zin 'gyur ste// thur du zin pas steng yang de bzhin no// zhes pas/ snod kyi chu dang ril ba zhabs tshags can bzhin no// de la 'byung ba rang rang gi rlung gi 'dzin stangs kyis/ ā li kā li'i ser gtso ma'i mdog can/ me tog phreng ba lta bu se na ra ra dus me'i steng du babs pas/ se hram me ba la dmigs pa gtad/ de la nan tan du bsgom zhing*/ mi thub par gtong ba'i dus su/ rlung phyir 'byung ba dang 'grogs nas yig 'bru rnams kyang gyen la se na ra ra song bar bsgom mo// sa rlung zin pa'i rtags gong dang 'dra'o// yang sngar bzhin zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/

chu'i rlung gi 'dzin stangs kyis/ ā li kā li mu tig gi phreng ba lta bu/ dkar hram me ba la dmigs pa gtad/ rlung phyir 'byung ba'i dus dkar na ra ra song bar bsam/ yang sngar bzhin nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du/ me rlung gi 'dzin stangs kyis/ ā li kā li bye ru'i mdog lta bu dmar na ra ra byung nas/ dmar hram me ba la dmigs pa gtad/ phyir dbyungs ba na dmar na ra ra song bar bsam/ me rlung zin pa'i rtags gong dang 'dra'o// yang sngar bzhin sgra gcan gyi gdan gyi steng du/ rlung gi rlung 'dzin stangs kyis ā li kā li nag po na ra ra byung nas/ nag hram me ba la dmigs pa gtad de/ phyir 'byung ba nag na ra ra song bar bsam/ rlung zin pa'i rtag gong dang 'dra'o// yang sngar bzhin ye shes kyi gdan gsal gdab/ ā li kā li bai ḍūr+ya mdog lta bu na ra ra byung nas/ sngo hram me ba la dmigs pa gtad/ rlung zin pa'i rtags (532)sngar dang 'dra'o// de thams cad kyi thun mgo la lta stangs bsgom/ de nas thur ser gyi rlung bsgom/ de nas steng rlung bsgom pa yin gsung*/ de ni steng srog rtsol gyi rlung zhes bya/ pho rlung zhes bya ste/ steng nas 'jug pa yin no// de dag brtan pa dang*/ bar rlung la brten nas phyag mtshan bskyed pa ni/ rdo rje ral gri rin chen pad+ma dang*/ 'khor lo rnams ni rim bzhin gsal bar blta/ steng 'og bar gsum bsdams pas thob par 'gyur/ zhes pas/ rang rang gi rlung gi 'dzin stangs kyis// steng rlung bzung 'og rlung then te/ bar rlung bzung nas steng 'og gnyis glod de/ gdan la gnas pa'i sa bon rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ rim pa bzhin du/ rdo rje sngon po dang*/ ral gri nag po dang*/ rin po che dmar po dang*/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad dkar po dang*/ 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad ser po rnams bsgom par bya'o// de rnams bar rlung gi sbyor ba ste/ rlung sems steng 'og bar gsum dang yan lag gang du yang 'drongs shing nang gzhi thams cad la chags pa med pa la sogs pa'i yon tan mang po yod pa yin/

'ga' zhig gsus pa rgal pa la sbyar nas bsgom par 'dod pa yod de/ des gsus pa was brus pa bzhin 'gro ba yin/ rgya gar gyi grub chen rnams kyi gsus pa ji ltar 'dug /de gnyis kyi gnad des shes pa yin gsungs/ de yan chad kyis steng 'og gi srog rtsol gyi gnad bstan nas/ 'dzin pa la kha sbyor gyi rlung gis lha slong ba'i rnal 'byor gsungs pa/ snod bcud tha mal 'dzin pa rab spangs te/ gdan dang phyag mtshan yig 'bru gsal ba las// (533)rigs las skyes pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku// gdan dang lung bu ske rag tshangs skud dang*// phyag dang zhal dang spyan dang skra mtshams dang*// rgyan dang cha lugs ma lus rab rdzogs nas// gtsug tor bar du rim bzhin gsal bar blta// zhes pas ste/ snod bcud ces pa ni/ brtan g.yo'i dngos po thams cad dang*/ de rnams ni rdul phra rab dang bral zhing*/ dbyings rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pas/ tha mal du 'dzin pa dang bral ba/ de mngon du byed pa'i thabs/ zung 'jug gi lha sku bsgom pa ste/ de yang gdan dang*/ yig 'bru dang*/ phyag mtshan la sogs pa bsgom pa las/ rigs ni lnga'am drug go /de yang bskyed rim gyi mthar thug skad cig krong bskyed pa yin pas/ sngar gyi sa bon dang phyag mtshan re re'i skabs su/ lha sku rigs dang mthun pa re re slong ba yin te/ rim gyis slong ba la rang rang gi steng 'og bar gsum gyis rlung gi 'dzin stangs kyis/ 'byung ba rim brtsegs dang*/ gdan dang*/ sa bon dang*/ phyag mtshan rnams bsgoms nas/ kha sbyor gyi lha sku bskyed pa yin la/ de yang nam mkha'i khams nas bskyed pa de/ rdo rje sngon po yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo'am/ bde mchog la sogs pa'i lha yab yum krongs kyis bskyed de/ rim par gsal gdab pa ni/ cung zhig 'og gi rlung sbyor gsal bas/ lta stangs smad la bde mchog la rim pa'i gdan dang*// 'jigs byed dus mtshan dang*/

yab sku mdog sngon po/ yum dmar (534)mo// gnyis ka'i long bu dang*/ zhabs gdub dang*/ sku smad dang*/ mkha' gsang byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ stag lpags dang*/ bar rlung gsal bas/ rked pa dang*/ ske rags dang*/ sku stod dang*/ tshangs skud dang*/ do shal dang*/ mgul rgyan dang*/ phyag dang*/ phyag mtshan dang*/ gdu bu dang*/ dpung rgyan dang*/ steng rlung gsal bas zhal dang*/ shangs dang*/ spyan dang*/ gtsug tor dang*/ nor bu dang*/ snyan dang*/ snyan cha dang*/ thod phreng dang*/ ral pa'i thor cog dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ zla ba phyed pa dang*/ yum gyi skra grol ba dang*/ dar dbyangs la sogs pa rnams rim pa bzhin gsal la ma 'dres par gsal gdab/ de yang*/ spyi ma gsal na spyi gsal gdab/ bye brag ma gsal na bye brag gsal gdab/ ji srid brtan pa ma thob kyi bar du bsgom pa'o// gtsug tor nas bzung gdan gyi bar de bzhin no// yang gtsug tor nas bzung nas gdan gyi bar du ste/ yas rims kyis gong bzhin gsal 'debs pa'o// de rnams ni kha sbyor gyi rlung zhes bya/ bum pa can gyi rlung sbyor ro// de ltar lha yab rnams ni lo bcu drug gi na tshod can/ yum rnams ni lo bcu gnyis kyi na tshod tsam bsgoms na mchog ster la/ gzhan du nyon mongs pa kho nar 'gyur ro// de yang brtson 'grus dang ldan pas// nyin mtshan du ma yengs par bsgom pa kho na la yin gyis/ gzhan du na lo brgya'i mthar yang dngos grub 'grub pa ma yin no// de ltar rlung nang du slongs shing bskyed rim brtan pa'i dus su/ snang ba thams cad snang (535)stong dbyer med pa bar snang gi 'ja' tshon nam/ sgyu ma lta bur snang la rang ngo sprad gsung*/ de nas drod dang bde ba'i bog dbyung bar 'dod na/ lha me khams pa gsal ba'i lte ba nas sor bzhi'i 'og tu nyi ma'i gdan la pad+ma kha dog dmar po gsal ba'i mdangs dang ldan pa/ reg bya shin tu tsha ba la dmigs pa gtad nas/ me rlung btsan thabs su 'dzin pa yin no// bde ba la bde chen 'khor lo'i haṃ las/

byang sems kyi rgyun thig pa babs pa lta bur ā li ka li'i rnam par ste/ 'og tu 'bab ste lus thams cad bde bas khyab bar bsgom/ 'di'i skabs su rtsa ba'i gtso mo gsum po gsal btab kyang 'ong gsung*/ de srog rtsol gyi yan lag rdo rje'i bzlas par 'gyur ba ni/ 'byung 'jug gnas gsum rtsa ba'i rlung rnams kyang*/ de dus sku gsung thugs kyi bzlas par 'gyur/ zhes pas/ srog rtsol gyi dus su 'jug pa oṃ/ phyir 'byung ba āḥ gnas pa hūm̐ du 'gyur pas rim pa bzhin/ sku gsung thugs kyi bzlas par 'gyur ba'o// de bzhin du thur sel la yang*/ dri chen dang*/ dri chu dang*/ khu ba'i rtsa rnams 'gags pa las kyang rim pa bzhin du/ sku gsung thugs kyi bzlas par 'gyur te/ gzhan yang*/ g.yon zla ba'i rtsal rgyu ba'i rlung sku rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang*/ g.yas nyi ma'i rtsa la rgyu ba'i rlung gsung rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang*/ dbus sgra gcan gyi rtsa la rgyu ba thugs rdo rje'i bzlas pa'o// de ltar rlung gang nas rgyu ba bltas la/ de dang de la bzlas pa bya'o// ji ltar byed na/ bgrang phreng med cing sngags bzlos pa'am med par/ (536)dbugs kyi 'byung 'jug dang lhan gcig yi ge gsum la sogs pa sngags kyi rim pa rnams dbugs 'byung 'jug dang bstun no/ me tog gi phreng ba bzhin du bltas nas/ rang rang gi sor tshad dang ldan par 'jug pa dang*/ 'byung ba'i rim pa bsgom lags so// yang do li'i bzlas pa ni/ sngags kyi phreng ba yab kyi thugs ka'i sa bon las thon/ dbu ma'i lam brgyud yum gyi mkhar babs sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon la thim pa ni/ bde stong bskyed pa'i bzlas pa yin gsungs/ yang rlung bsnyen par bgrang ba zhes pa ni lus bsam gtan gyi chos lnga dang ldan pa'i lag pa gnyis pus mo la dgab/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i lte bar las dang rjes su mthun pa'i phyag mtshan gdan dang bcas pa bskyed la/

yig 'bru rnams phyag mtshan la 'khor ba la rig pa 'dzin pa ste/ de dang mnyam du gsus pa g.yas g.yon du res mos su bskor ba yin/ phyogs gcig tu bskor na yon po'i gegs 'ong gsung*/ srog rtsol 'gog pa'i bzlas pa zhes pa la/ srog ni gyen du rgyu ba'i rlung yin la/ rtsol ba ni khrid kyi lag len gyis rlung lam du byed pa'o// de ltar srog rtsol gyis nyi zla'i 'gro 'ong 'gags pa ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi gsung du 'gyur zhing*/ de ltar nyams su blangs pas/ srog rlung thig le'i nang du tshud nas/ rlung sems haṃ gi yi ger zin pa ni/ 'dzin pa zhes pa ste/ srog rtsol gyi 'bras bu yin gsungs/ srog rtsol gyi phrin las chen po bzhi'am/ las chen po rnams bsgrub par bstan (537)pa ni/ rang rang rigs kyis 'byung ba'i kha dog bzhin// zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod rim pa yin// zhes pas/ srog rtsol gyi rnal 'byor kha bsgyur bas/ zhi ba dang rgyas pa dang dbang dang drag po'i las dang*/ rengs pa dang*/ rmongs pa dang*/ dgug pa dang*/ dbye ba la sogs pa 'grub pa ste/ de yang srog rtsol gyi rnal 'byor dang lhan cig sngags kyi phreng ba yid kyis bzlas pas las 'grub pa ste/ de yang*/ chu rlung bzhi sbyor zhi ba'i las// zhes gsungs pas/ 'og rlung gis chu'i dkyil 'khor dang zla gdan bsgom/ steng rlung gis sa bon gyi yig 'bru bsgom/ bar rlung gis phyag mtshan pad+ma bsgom/ kha sbyor gyis lha chu khams pa bskyed/ de nas rlung rlung gzhil ba'i tshul gyis bum pa can du bya ste/ lte ba zla ba'i gdan la phyag mtshan pad+ma dkar po reg bya bsil ba bsgom/ de nas rlung btsan thabs dbu mar bcug la/ gsang ba ye shes kyi rlung sbyor gyis/ bsgrub bya dang sems bsres phyag mtshan gyi 'od zer gyis bsgrub bya bkug la phyag mtshan la bstims te/ oṃ mā ma kī ri kī ri che ge mo shan+tiṃ ku ru na maḥzhes yid kyis bzlas pas zhi ba'i las 'grub bo// sa rlung bzhi sbyor rgyas pa'i las zhes pas/

gong bzhin la lha sa khams pa bskyed/ dus me'i steng du 'khor lo ser po bsgom/ sa rlung dbu mar bcug bsgrub bya dang sems bsre phyag mtshan gyi 'od zer gyis bsgrub bya bkug la bstim/ oṃ le tsa ni bha su dhi che ge mo puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes pas rgyas par byed do// me rlung kha sbyor dbang gi (538)las/ zhes pas gong bzhin la lha me khams pa bskyed/ nyi ma'i steng du rin po che dmar po bsgom/ rlung dbu mar bcug /bsgrub bya dang sems bsres/ phyag mtshan gyi 'od zer gyis/ bsgrub bya bkug la bstim/ oṃ paṇ+ḍa ra ba si ni ba ra te che ge mo bhau swā hā/ zhes pas dbang du byed do// rlung gi rlung kha sbyor drag po'i las/ zhes pas/ gong bzhin la lha rlung khams pa bskyed/ sgra gcan gyi steng du ral gri nag po bsgom/ rlung gi rlung dbu mar bcug /bsgrub bya dang sems bsre/ phyag mtshan gyi 'od zer gyis bsgrub bya bkug la bstims/ phyag mtshan las 'od zer mtshon cha mang po 'phros pas/ srog dang phral bar bsgom zhing*/ oṃ tā re tu t+tā re tu re che ge mo mā ra ya hūm̐/ zhes pas/ bsad pa'i las 'grub po/ bskrad pa dang phyag mtshan gyi 'od zer nus pa dang ldan pas/ rlung ltar mgyogs pa'i rnga mo la skyon nas/ che ge mo u tsa ṭa ya hūm̐/ zhes pas rgyangs ring du 'phang bar bsgom/ rengs pa la/ oṃ lo tsa na ba su de che ge mo stam bha ya phaṭa/ ces pas 'grub bo/ dgug pa la/ che ge mo kha'u ṣaṭa/ ces pas 'grub bo/ rmongs pa la/ che ge mo ha ya phaṭa/ ces pas 'grub po// dbye ba la/ phan tshun stobs 'gran pa'i 'od zer phog pas bsgrub bya rnams bya rog dang 'ug par gyur pas 'thab cing rtsod par bsgom ste/ che ge mo dag pra be sha ya phaṭa/ ces pas 'grub bo// nam mkha'i rlung bzhi sbyor ni gong bzhin la lha nam mkha'i khams pa bskyed/ nam mkha'i gdan la rdo rje sngon po ljang (539)khu bsgom/

rlung dbu mar bcug /bsgrub bya dang sems bsre/ phyag mtshan gyi 'od zer gyis bsgrub bya bkug la bstim ste/ gang sgrub pa de mi snang bar bsgoms pas/ mi snang bar 'gyur gsungs/ res 'ga' phyag mtshan bsgom pa'i gnad 'di snying ga dang spyi gtsug la sogs pa 'byung ba'i rlung gi gnad so sor 'byed pa 'ong gsungs/ res 'ga' steng 'og bar gsum ma ning ye shes kyi rlung dang bzhi la so sor sbyar ba yang gsungs/ las chen 'di rnams sgrub pa la/ sngon la stong pa nyid kyi gzugs bstan nas/ de rjes srog rtsol gyi dbang thob pa gcig dgos pa yin gsungs/ 'byung ba'i rlung rnams rang rang 'dzin stangs kyis// bskyod par gyur tshe rlung gi me sbar nas// dngas ma zhu bas mi zad nyon mongs 'bar// ces pas/ 'byung ba'i rlung dang so so'i 'dzin stangs gong du bshad cing bskyod pa ni steng 'og bar gsum gyi rlung dbang du byed pa'o// sbyor ba des lte bar gtum mo'i me sbar te/ khams kyi dngas ma haṃ yig gi rnam pa spyi bo nas zhugs te/ shin tu mi zad pa'i nyon mongs 'bar ba ste/ de la chags pa'i 'dod rtags bcu 'char ba'o// dus 'khor las kyang*/ bsam dang 'dod dang lus la rims dang kha mchog pad+ma skam dang zas la rab tu mi 'jug dang*// 'dar dang smyo dang rab tu rmongs dang 'gyur dang yid ni rnam par 'khrul dang drag tu rgyal ba dga'// rdo rje can gyi du ba la sogs rab gsal rnam pa bcu ste srog chags lus la 'jig rten du// rab tu gsal zhing nges par de rnams yid bsrubs gnas skabs (540)su zhig rgyal ba 'dod pa de ni gsungs// zhes gsungs so// rtsigs ma bad kan chu ser khrag dang ni// sha dang rus pa rgyus pa'i bcud rnams kyis// rang rang gnas su nad dang lus zung bskyed// ces pas ro drug dang ldan pa'i zas sko ma bsten pas/ de nyid lus zungs bdun du 'gyur ba ste/

de nyid lto bar mnyam gnas kyi rlung gis dngas snyigs phye ba las/ lus zungs bdun gyi dang po dwangs mar gyur pa de yang 'byung ba'i mthus dwangs snyigs gnyis su phye ste/ rtsigs ma bad kan dang*/ dwangs ma khrag tu 'gyur ro// khrag gi dwangs ma sha dang*/ rtsigs ma mkhris par 'gyur ro// sha'i dwangs ma tshil dang*/ rtsigs ma mig la sogs pa bu ga'i dri mar 'gyur ro// tshil gyi dwangs ma rus pa dang*/ rtsigs ma rdul du 'gyur ro// rus pa'i dwangs ma rkang dang*/ rtsigs ma sen mo dang*/ ba spu'o// rkang gi dwangs ma khu ba dang*/ rtsigs ma mig dang pags pa bshang ba'i sbug mo// khu ba'i dwangs ma stobs dang*/ rtsigs ma mdwangs su 'gyur ro// zas skom gyi snyigs ma ni/ thur sel gyi rlung gis phyir 'byin par byed de gshang lci'o// de la skabs bdun zhes pa'am/ skye ba bdun zhes pa'am/ lus zungs bdun zhes bya'o// lus kyi stobs rgyas pa dang*/ bkrag mdangs legs pa thams cad thig le'i yon tan yin no// lus la nad 'jug pa thams cad zas kyi dwangs snyigs ma phyed pas 'jug la/ nad thams cad bskyed pa 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung gis bskyed pa ste/ de yang lus zungs bdun nas rim par ltar 'jug pas/ thog mar pho bar me mnyam gyi rlung log (541)nas/ zas khrag dang bad kan du 'gro ma nus/ rtsigs ma 'dor ma nus pas ma zhu ba ste// skran dang ldan dang 'gar ba la sogs pa 'byung*/ bad kan la nad zhugs na zas mi 'ju/ dang kha mi bde/ pho ba'i me drod nyams pas lus kyi smad thams cad grang mor 'gro/ nad snying khrod du zhugs na snying rlung la sogs pa shes pa mi bde ba 'byung*/ chu ser la nang zhugs na chu ser 'phel bas/ rlung khrag byang chub kyi sems rgyu ba'i lam 'gags te zha 'khums la sogs pa 'byung*/ tshabs che na mthar mdze ru 'gro/ chu ser gyi nad la gsang btsal la ber ka bya/ khab btsag gis khrag 'don/ gzhan yang chu ser dang rlung sdongs pas lus thams cad skrangs nas mthar dmu chu ru 'gro ba ste/

khyab byed kyi rlung log pa yin gsung*/ khrag la nad zhugs na tshad pa skye/ lus kyi stod dang mchin pa la zug 'byung dbugs thung pa dang*/ gzhan dag bad kan smug po zer/ de la gdon gyis skyon ni/ glo dang gzer thung du 'gro gsungs/ sha la nad zhugs na/ dbang po lnga la skyon 'byung ste/ yan lag gi rlung lnga'i bcos thabs kyis bsal/ rus pa la nad zhugs na/ rus pa khog 'gyur ba byung na/ kong brus byed dgos/ gdams ngag gi sel bar dka' gsung*/ tshil lam rkang mar la nang zhugs na/ thig le'i bzhu btul gyis sel gsungs/ thig le la skyon byung na/ 'dzag pa'i skyon bdun sel thabs dang*/ 'dzag sgo bzhi'i bcing thabs la 'bad dgos gsungs/ lus zungs bskyod pa ni/ gang gi gdams pa'i gnad rnams ma 'khrul pa dang*/ bdud rtsi (542)lnga phrug nyi shu rtsa lnga phyi nang gsang gsum du zos pas/ lus kyi zungs bskyed pa yin gsungs/ lus zungs kyi dwangs ma phyi rol du 'phos pa'i skyon ni/ lus zungs zla ba'i cha yis 'pho ba las// yan lag bcu gnyis srid pa'i lugs bzhin 'khor// zhes pas/ lus zungs ni sngar brjod pa'i bad kan la sogs pa yin la/ de rnams kyi dwangs ma ni khu ba'o// de nyid thabs dang bcas pa rnams kyis mi 'gyur bar brtan pas mchog thob la/ thabs dang bral ba rnams kyis/ bha ga la sogs par 'phos pa/ ma rig pa nas bzung ste rga shi'i bar gyi rten 'brel bcu gnyis lugs su zhugs nas 'khor ba'o// de nyid mi 'pho ba sgrub pa ni rjes su dran pa ste/ sgra gcan gyis ni rab tu zos pa las/ me dpung rab tu 'bar bas bsreg par byed// ces pas sgra gcan ni dbu ma'o// bza' bar bya ba ni dwangs ma byang chub kyi sems rab tu zos pa ni nor bur brtan pa'o// me dpung rab tu 'bar ba ni/ ye shes kyi 'od zer te mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba'o// bsreg pa ni 'pho ba'i bde ba dang bag chags spangs pa'o// de'i stobs gyis brtan pa'i dga' ba'i ye shes rim pa bzhin 'char zhing*/

'khor ba'i rten 'brel bcu gnyis lugs las bzlog pa'o// de la yang rtsigs ma thur du 'dos shing dwangs ma gnas su zin pa gcig dgos pas/ rtsigs ma thur du song pas nad med cing*/ dwangs ma lus la rgyas pas bde ba 'phel/ zhes pas/ rtsig ma ni ro drug gi zas skom longs spyod pa'i rtsigs ma dri chen dri chu la sogs pa'o// de la chags pa chen po des bzhu brtul du gyur pas/ byang chub kyi sems (543)'dzag med du byas shing*/ rtsigs ma shes ma thur du 'dor bas lus la nad kyis mi tshugs shing*/ dwangs ma dang stobs rgyas pas/ 'dos pa'i yon tan thob ste/ bdud bzhi'i dpung rnams 'joms par byed do// rigs drug sa bon bsregs par gyur ba las// 'dzag pa'i bde ba rim gyis skye ba'i phyir// steng 'og bar gsum bar tu bsdam par bya// zhes gsungs pas/ bzung ba dang 'dzin pa ro mnyam par 'gyur ba med pa'i bde ba thob pa ste rigs drug ni/ nam mkha' rlung me chus ye shes kyi rigs so// sa bon ni/ a i ri u li a rnams so// de rnams gtum mo ye shes kyi me yis bsreg par gyur ba las/ zhu ba 'dzag pa'i bde ba skye ba ste/ de bsrung ba'i don du steng 'og bar gsum rab tu bsdam par byed do// srog dang thur sel dang bar rlung kha sbyor du sgom zhing 'dzag med bsgrub pa'o// gzhung de nyid kyi byed las/ rlung gis me sbar sa sregs chu bzhu ste/ nam mkha' stong pa'i don la 'jug par 'gyur/ rlung gi sbyor ba ni steng 'og bar gsum bsdams pa'o// de'i stobs kyis gtum mo'i me 'bar bas/ phung po dang khams dang skye mched la sogs pa rnams bsreg pa ste/ yas babs pa'i dga' ba la sogs pa'i rim pa rnams rdo rje nor bu'i bar du byon pa'o// de nyid steng 'og bar gsum rab tu bsdams pa'i sbyor bas/ 'bras bu mngon du ma gyur bar du bsgom par bya// nam mkha' stong ba'i don ni/

sngags kyi don zhes pa'am/ gnyis su med pa zhes pa'am/ stong pa nyid kyi don zhes pa yin no// de sngar bshad pa'i lam gyis/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba ma thob na/ sbogs pa'i cho (544)ga'am/ gsang ba'i lag len bstan pa ni// rdo rje bslang zhing gsor ba'i bde ba yis// thog ma bar dang mtha' ma'i bde ba 'chang*// dgug gzhug bcing zhing ro mnyam bstan par bya// rim pa des ni nges par 'grub par 'gyur// zhes pas rdo rje a wa dhu ti yin la/ bslang ba ni nā da goms par byed pa'o// de'i rim pa ni/ srog rtsol gyi rlung sbyor gyis steng 'og bar gsum gyi rlung la dbang byed pa'o// yang na/ rdo rje nor bu lag pa'i chu skyes su bzhag pas/ thog mtha' bar gsum gyi dge ba rdzogs shes pa dang*/ rim pa 'dis nges par 'grub pa ni/ steng 'og bar gsum gyi rlung 'chings pas/ 'gyur ba med pa'i ye shes 'grub bo zhes pa'o// sgrub pa chen po'i rten gyi mtshan nyid de/ thabs kyi me gsum rab tu 'bar ba dang*/ shes rab la yang me gsum de bzhin te// zhes pas/ thabs shes rab gnyis ka la rjes chags kyi me gsum gsum ste/ lang tsho dus kyi me/ sgom pa ting nge 'dzin gyi me/ spyod pa bsgrub pa las byung ba'i me'o// res 'ga' lang tsho dang*/ chags pa dang*/ sgom pa'i me zhes kyang gsungs so// phan tshun rigs dang rigs kyis 'brel ba ni/ sa dang chu dang me dang rlung rnams dang*// nam mkha' las skyes de bzhin gshegs pa'i yum// zhes pas/ sa chu me dang nam mkha' rnams ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yum ste/ rim pa bzhin du/ spyan ma/ mā ma ki dang*/ gos dkar mo dang*/ sgrol ma dang*/ rdo rje dbyings phyug ma rnams so// rigs de rnams las skyes pa'i rigs can bud med kyi rigs dang lnga ru 'gyur zhing*/ phal cher 'dres pa'i rigs mang bar gsungs la/ de bzhin du/ thabs la'ang rigs lnga (545)ste/ thabs kyang rgyal ba rnams kyis rab phye ba// rang rang rigs sam lus dang sems dpa' las// rigs gzhan rnams dang 'dres pa gang la yang*// de dang de yi yab yum rigs kyis 'grub// ces pas/

thabs rnal 'byor pa dang*/ rgyal ba ste de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbye ba rigs lngar gsungs so// mi bskyod pa dang*/ don yod grub pa dang*/ rin chen 'byung ldan dang*/ snang ba mtha' yas dang*/ rnam par snang mdzad dang rim pa bzhin du/ nam mkha' rlung me chu sa'i rigs rnams so// lus dang bsam pa ni/ thabs shes rab la chags pas/ lus thabs su yod kyang bsam pa shes rab tu 'gro zhing*/ shes rab thabs la chags pas/ lus shes rab tu yod kyang*/ bsam pa thabs su 'gro ba'o// rigs gzhan ni/ rang gi rigs ma yin par thabs shes su bsdebs pa ste/ me dang chu/ sa dang chu/ nam mkha' dang ye shes su bsdebs pas 'grub pa'o// rigs 'dres pa la yang shas gang che brtags shing*/ gang yin shes par bya'o// yang na thabs kyang zla ba nyi ma'i rigs// shes rab kyang ni nyi ma zla ba'o// shes rab kyi nyi ma'i rigs ni gzugs dang skad mdog gi rnam 'gyur gyis rang gzugs su gnas shing rdul gnam stong la 'bab pa ste nyi ma'i rigs/ shes rab kyi zla ba'i rigs ni/ gzugs dang skad mdog gi rnam 'gyur/ thabs kyi gzugs su gnas shing*/ rdul nya la 'bab pa ste zla ba'i rigs shes so// de gnyis kyang thabs shes 'grig pa gong bzhin no// 'khor lo drug dang nor bu'i rtse mo la// zla ba'i cha rnams rim gyis 'pho ba (546)dag /sgra gcan gyis ni rab tu zos pa las// de'i rjes su nyi ma'i cha rnams kyang*// rim pa bzhin du de ni za bar 'gyur// zhes pas/ 'khor lo drug gi lte ba dang snying ga la sogs pa yin la/ nor bu ni rdo rje nor bu ste/ zla ba'i cha ni khu ba'o// rim gyis 'pho ba ni dga' ba la sogs pa'i rim pas 'pho ba'o// sgra gcan ni dbu ma yin la/ zos pa ni zla ba/ 'pho ba'i bde ba la ltos pa med par gyen la log pa'o// de'i rjes su nyi ma'i cha zhes pa ni/ shes rab kyi rdul yang ā wa dhū tis za bar byed ces pa'o// nyi zla zos pa'i rjes la dri chen dang*// dri chu sha chen dbus kyi bcud kyang za// rtsigs ma bad kan chu ser khrag zos nas// sha dang rus pa rtsa rnams ma lus za// zhes pas/

nyi zla sgra gcan gyis zos nas/ rlung byang chub kyi sems kyi dwangs ma/ gtsug gtor gyi 'khor lo zin pa'i rjes su dri chen dri chu dang*/ sha chen nam dbus nas kyi bcud ces pas rkang rnams kyang za bas te/ gyen du 'gro zhing*/ de bzhin du/ bad kan dang*/ chu ser dang*/ khrag dang*/ sha dang*/ rus pa dang*/ rtsa rnams za bar byed do// nyi zla zos nas bde ba chen po 'gyur ba'i tshe// rtsigs ma 'di rnams dwangs mar 'gyur ba'o// phal ba'i lus la 'bab pa ma yin no// dag pa'i rten la 'bar ba'i me bsgrubs te// de'i phung po nges par bsreg par bya// ces pas/ phal ba'i lus 'di rgyu rkyen du ma'i sgo nas rtsa rlung byang chub kyi sems kyi nus pa chung ba'o// 'bar ba ma yin pa ste/ khyad par gyi dga' ba bzhi bskyed par mi nus pa'o// dag pa'i rten ni/ rgyud (547)yongs su smin cing theg chen la mos pa la sogs pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa la/ gtum mo'i me bsgrubs te/ de'i mes rnal 'byor pa de nyid kyi phung po bsreg par byed do// las kyi phyag rgyas mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba bsgrub pa'i tshul 'di ni/ rnal 'byor dbang po brtul po rnams kyi dbang du mdzad nas gsungs pa yin la/ dbang po 'bring rnams la ye shes kyi phyag rgyas bsgrub par gsungs shing*/ dbang po rnon po phyag rgya chen po kho nas/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po bsgrub par gsungs pa yin no// dbang po brtul bo la las kyi phyag rgya dgos pa yin no// lhan cig skyes pa'i sgom pa de nyid ni// nges par yul gyi rkyen las bsgom pa las// rmi lam shes pa de yi rjes su 'jug /ces pas/ lhan cig skyes pa zhes pa ni/ byang chub kyi sems rdo rje nor bur brtan pa der skyes pa'i ye shes so// sgom pa ni rdo rje nor bur 'pho chen gcig 'gags pa nas bzung nas/ sa bcu gnyis ma rdzogs kyi bar du bsgom pa'o// nges par yul gyi rkyen ni/

rgyud yongs su dag pa'i shes rab la bsten nas/ byang chub kyi sems brtan par byas pa yin/ rmi lam gyi shes pa yang de'i rjes su 'jug ste/ 'dzag pa'i bde ba don du gnyer ba'i bag chags rmi lam du spang ste/ bde ba chen po'i sems su 'gyur zhes pa'o// 'di la dbang po rno brtul gyi rim pas phyag rgya gang la bsten nas bsgrubs kyang*/ yid thig le dag par byed pa thugs rdo rje'i sgrub pa chen po zer ba yin gsungs/ ༈ gegs sel gyi don mdor bstan pa ni/ lus la (548)gnas pa rlung dang nad gzhi'i rtsigs// gyen du 'phang zhing 'og tu bcings pa dang*// thad kal bsrang zhing rang sar gzhil bar byas// yang nas dgong zhing zug ngu'i gnas su 'phang*// zhes pas/ lus ni rnal 'byor pa'am gzhan yang rung ste de la gnas pa'o// rlung dang nad gzhi'i rtsigs ni/ rlung ro dang khrag ngan dang zas kyi dngas snyigs ma phyed pa la sogs pa ste/ steng 'og gi gegs sel gyi gnad kyis gyen thur du 'ded pa dang*/ thad kar bsad pa ni/ dngas snyigs phyed cing dbyugs pas 'don pa dang*/ steng 'og bar gsum gyi gnad bcun pas/ skyon thams cad rang mal du zhi bar byed pa'o// gang zhig zug ngu'i gnas su 'phang pa ni/ steng 'og bar gsum gyi rlung bcun nas/ na zug gang yod pa'i sa ru rlung sems dril la/ nad thad ka na par phyu ru ru thon par bsam la/ 'khru 'khor gyis bcun pa'o// des ma sos na/ gnyen po'i bsam gtan gyis bcos pa ni/ sa dang chu dang me dang rlung rnams kyang*// dgra dang grogs su rang bzhin gnas pa las// tsha grangs gnyen po'i rim pas sbyang bar bya// ces pas/ sa rlung log pas shes pa lci zhing 'thibs nas/ rlung btsan thabs su bzung zhing*/ spyi bor sgra gcan gyi gdan la gnas pa'i yi ge yaṃ la dmigs pa bcun/ rlung gi rlung log pas shes pa 'phyo ba dang rgod pa las sa rlung btsan thabs su bzung la/ lte ba'am gshang lam du dus me'i gdan la yi ge laṃ la dmigs pa bcun/

me rlung log nas shes pa 'phro zhing tshig pa la/ chu rlung btsan thabs su bzung zhing*/ snying gar zla ba la gnas pa'i (549)baṃ yig la dmigs pa bcun/ chu rlung log nas shes pa 'dar ba dang*/ lus drod chung ba la me rlung btsan thabs su bzung zhing mgrin par nyi ma la gnas pa'i raṃ la dmigs pa bcun/ stong nyams kyi shes pa g.yang za ba la sogs pa byung na/ sa rlung btsan thabs su bzung zhing*/ lte ba'i bshang lam du sa'i gdan la yi ge laṃ la dmigs pa bcun/ nam mkha'i rlung btsan thabs su bzung bas kun gyi grogs su gyur pa yin gsungs/ yang steng srog rtsol la brten nas/ dgra dang sprad pa dang*/ grogs dang bsdebs pa ni/ lus la tshad pa'i nad byung na me dgra chu yin pas/ 'og tu gdan chu'i dkyil 'khor 'dom gang ba zlum po/ kha dog dkar po reg bya shin tu bsil ba cig bsgom/ snying gar chu'i dkyil 'khor lag mthil tsam cig bsgom/ de'ang reg bya shin tu bsil bar bsgoms pa'i steng du/ baṃ dkar po rnam pa yig 'bru la ngo bo chu ru 'dug pa cig bsgoms la/ chu rlung bzung zhing*/ yi ge dang dkyil 'khor gnyis las chu tshub bun bun byung nas lus kyi nang thams cad gang bar bsgom/ 'og gi chu'i dkyil 'khor las kyang chu tshub rba klong thol thol ba byung nas/ lus kyi phyi nang chu tshub kyis gang bar bsgom/ khyad par du nad yod pa'i sar chu 'khyags su bsam/ spyir tshad nad thams cad stod nas 'jug cing*/ 'byung ba cha ma snyoms pa'i nad thams cad dang po snying ka nas bskyed pa yin te/ 'byung ba bzhi ka'i rtsa 'dus yod pa'i phyir ro// 'di rnams la 'og rlung mi sdom par rang sor bzhag pas chog /lus skyil krung bya/ lag pa (550)pus mo la dgab/ grogs dang sdeb pa ni/ chu'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'og tu/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor rab tu g.yo ba gcig bsgom/ de las rlung byung zhing rlung gi rlung bsam/ chu tshub la rlung gi grogs byas nas/

shin tu grang bas bzod glags med par bsgom mo// lus la grang ba skyes na chu dgra me yin pas/ lus gnad ni gong bzhin te/ 'og ma rnams la yang shes par bya'o// gdan me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po 'bar bar bsam/ nang du a thung gi gnas su me'i dkyil 'khor lag mthil tsam raṃ gyis mtshan pa cig bsam/ me phyi nang gnyis kar yang reg bya tsha ba/ mgar ba'i sol mal lta bur bsgom zhing me rlung bzung ste/ yi ge dang dkyil 'khor gnyis las me tshub byung bar bsgom pas/ grogs dang sdebs pa ni me'i 'og tu rlung gi dkyil 'khor bsgom/ de nas rlung bzung zhing*/ dkyil 'khor las rlung byung bas/ me phyi nang gnyis kar rlung gis bus pas/ rab tu 'bar zhing shin tu tsha bar bsgom des nges par sel lo// lus lci zhing 'thibs na/ sa dgra rlung yin pas/ 'og tu rlung gi dkyil 'khor 'dom gang ba nag po gzhu'i dbyibs can bsgom/ snying gar rlung gi dkyil 'khor lag mthil tsam yaṃ gyis mtshan pa bsgoms la/ sems yer gyis gzengs bstod do// rlung gis rlung bzung bas/ yig 'bru dang dkyil 'khor las rlung byung bas phyi nang gi rlung gis g.yo ba 'degs pa/ bu yug 'tshubs pa la dmigs pa gtad pas sel lo// grogs dang bsdeb pa ni/ phyi nang gnyis ka'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'og tu/ nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor sngon po chos 'byung gi dbyibs can/ rang bzhin gyis stong pa gcig (551)bsgoms la/ nam mkha'i rlung bzung zhing*/ nam mkha' phyi nang gnyis kar rgya je cher 'phel bas mthar lus ngag yid gsum thams cad nam mkhar song bar bsgom zhing*/ ma bcos blo bral du bzhag go /der nam mkha' cher rgyas pas rlung 'phel te/ des nad thams cad sel ba yin gsungs/ shes pa zi zhing 'phyo na rlung dgrangs pa yin pas/ 'og tu sa'i dkyil 'khor 'dom gang ba gru bzhi pa bsgom/ snying gar sa'i dkyil 'khor lag pa tsam gyis mtshan pa/

phyi nang gnyis ka yang shin tu lci ba/ gser gyi rang bzhin lta bur bsgom/ sa rlung gzung pas rkyen gang gis kyang g.yo bar mi nus par bsgom pas sel lo// rlung la grang ba'i cha med pas cung zad ma sos na/ sa'i grogs me yin pas/ sa'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyi nang gnyis ka'i 'og tu/ me'i dkyil 'khor dmar nag reg bya shin tu tsha ba re bsgom zhing*/ me rlung bzung bas me 'bar ba'i nus pas grol nas/ nad dang rlung 'thon no// yang gdan dang snying gar nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor che chung gang bzhin bsgom pas/ gnyis ka yi ge es mtshan ba stong pa'i rang bzhin can sngo song nge ba bsgoms te/ nam mkha'i rlung bzung zhing rnam par mi rtog pa la bzhag /de ltar bsgoms pas stong nyams mthar thug pa skye'o// de'i dgra dang sprad pa ni/ phyi nang gnyis ka'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sa'i dkyil 'khor re bsgoms pas/ ā li kā li gser gtso ma'i mdog lta bu spyi bo nas zhugs te snying ga'i dkyil 'khor la thim pas/ dkyil 'khor yig 'bru'i rnam par gyur/ de'i 'og gi dkyil 'khor la thim zhing*/ mthar rang gi lus (552)kyang dkyil 'khor la thim pas/ sa'i dkyil 'khor 'phel nas stong gsum thams cad gser gyi sa gzhir song ba la dmigs te/ sa rlung bzung ngo*// 'di 'dra spyan lnga ka la gzhug go /grogs sdebs pa rnams ni/ sngon la dgra dang sprad pas ma sos na byed pa'o// steng gi nyes pa 'og tu bcings pas sel// 'og gi log rnams steng gis de bzhin no// zhes pas/ steng gi nyi zla sgra gcan dang gsum gyis rtsa rlung thig le rnams lte ba yan chad du log pas ste/ rlung bus pas/ mgo na ba dang*/ shes pa zi ba la sogs pa/ stod kyi nad thams cad 'og gi rlung sbyor gyis thur du bcad pas sel la/ 'og gi log ni/ lte ba man chad du dri chen dang khu ba 'bab pa'i rtsa rlung thig le rnams log pa ste/ de la dri chen dri chu sdom pa'am dus min du 'chor ba dang*/

'og sgo lugs pa dang*/ 'og sgo rma dang rnag 'bur byung pa la sogs pa'o// de rnams la steng rlung sbyor gyis gyen du bcud pas sel lo// spyir rang gegs sel thams cad mdor bsdu na/ stod gegs thams cad 'og gis 'chos shing*/ smad gegs thams cad steng gis bcos pa yin te/ da lta 'od kyi rtsa rlung pa rnams la 'di'i gnad yod pa mi gda' gsungs/ ha hā hi hī hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyi sgra// steng du bsgrags pas rtsigs ma 'don pa dang*// dwangs ma rang gi gnas su 'dzin par byed// ces pas/ stod kyi nad gyen du 'don pa ste/ srog rlung sa'i rigs su 'thums pas/ shes pa lci zhing 'thib pa dang*/ rjed ngas che zhing ro stod na ba dang*/ snying mi dga' ba la sogs pa 'byung ngo*// rmi lam du yang rlung 'thums pa'i rtags byung na/ ha 'don pa ste/ de yang ha ring po dang*/ thung ngu (553)dang ma ning gi ha dang gsum las/ lus gnad skyil krung byas/ tshigs pa drang por bsrang*/ lag pa gnyis pus mo la dgab/ dmigs pa snying gi nang du rlung sems kyi thig le kha dog ser po'i steng du/ ha gser btso ma'i mdog lta bu'i ha mgo gyen du langs pa cig bsam/ mdun gyi nam mkhar yang thig le ser po'i steng du/ ha ser po gcig bsgoms la/ snying nang gi ha las ha ser po gcig rting ma gcig breng ma chad par kha na yang rgyangs rgyangs 'thon nas nam mkha'i ha la thim par bsam/ 'don lugs 'byung ba sa'i 'gros dang bstun nas/ ha ring po dbugs kyis thub tshad 'don 'phro gcod dus/ snying nang gi ha bton pa nam mkha'i ha la bstim ste/ nam mkhar 'ja' yal ba bzhin song bar bsam mo// chu rlung 'thums nas shes pa 'dar zhing grang ba la sogs pa byung ba'am/ me rlung 'thums nas lus tsha zhing shes pa 'tshubs pa la sogs pa'am rlung gi rlung 'thums nas/ 'gro snying 'dod pa'am/ shes pa yang zhing 'phyo ba la sogs pa'am/ nam mkha'i rlung 'thums nas snying mi dga' ba dang*/

stong sangs khyer ba la sogs pa byung na/ lus gnad dang dmigs pa gong bzhin byas nas/ rang rang gi kha dog can gyi ha 'byung ba rang rang gi 'gros dang bstun nas/ gong bzhin snying nang nas ha rang rang gi kha dog can bton nas/ nam mkhar ha ljang khu la bstim mo// nam mkha'i ha ni mi rtog pa la 'jog pa'i dus la sogs par yang rgyun du ma chad par bton nas gegs rnying pa rnams sel zhing*/ gsar pa mi 'jug pa dang*/ nyams myong la bogs (554)thon pa la sogs pa'i yon tan mang du yod pa yin gsungs/ ha thung las 'dags pa'i dus su lus gnad gong bzhin bya zhing*/ 'jug tu cung zhig 'byongs nas langs nas 'don pa dang*/

ha 'don pa'i dus su/ rkang lag sprug pa dang*/ 'khrab pa la sogs pa byed pa dang*/ mi byed pa'i khyad par gang lags/ skyon yon ci 'dog zhus pas/ nad kyi rigs 'ga' zhig la de rnams mi dgos par ha bton par rang gis sel ba'i rigs kyang yod/ 'ga' zhig la de bzhin ma byas ma mi chun pa'i rigs yod pas/ de la sprugs pa la sogs byas pas myur du 'grig pa yin pas byed dgos pa yin/ yang ha ring 'ga' zhig la 'khrab pa la sogs pas 'don lugs dang chun che ba yang yod pa yin gsungs/ 'khrab pa la sogs pa gang la 'jug gi gnad shes par byas nas/ dmigs pa gong bzhin bsgom ste/ sa rlung gi ha ni thung la 'jam pa/ chu rlung gi ha ni 'jur zhing thung la dal ba/ me rlung gi ha ni rtsub la thung ba/ rlung gi rlung gi ha ni thung zhing dal la snyoms pa ste/ de ltar rang rang gi 'gros dang mthun par 'don no// 'phro gcod pa'i dus su/ rang rang gi hā ring po bton la bzhag /de ltar gyen du 'phangs pa'i rjes la/ 'og tu yang bcing dgos te/ 'phangs kyang ma bcings na phan chung ba yin gsung*/ ma ning gi ha ni/ dwangs ma 'dzin zhing rtsigs ma 'dor ba ste// gzhan yang rtsa chu bsdams pa la sogs 'og rlung las mi byed pa dang*/ snying rlung dang*/ smyo 'bog dang*/ 'khrugs dang*/ ma 'ju ba dang*/ skran dang*/ dmu chu dang*/ rtsa rlung gi gegs thams cad sel bar byed pa yin no// ha ring po dang thung ngu dang bar pa cig rang shugs kyis 'don pa yin te/ man ngag zhal las shes so// hi hī ni/ (555)mgrin pa gyen rgyu'i rlung log nas/ tsha 'gags la sogs pa byung na lus gnad gong bzhin byas la/ hī ring dang hi thung gis 'don par bya'o// hūm̐ hūm̐ dang phaṭa ni gong bzhin gyi gegs sel ba la dgos so// byang chub kyi sems 'dren pa dang*/ 'grems pa la yang dgos pas/ lus gnad hā ring bzhin byas la/ drag zhan dang ring thung rig pas brtags la 'don par bya'o// yaṃ raṃ laṃ dang baṃ gyi yi ge'i sgras/

dkyil 'khor rab tu g.yo ba bsgrag cing gdab// rtsol ba drag pos rtsa gsum 'og tu bsdam// 'byed 'dzum des ni rtsigs ma thur du 'gro// zhes pas/ smad kyi nad dang rtsigs ma thur du byung ba la/ lus gnad skyil krung bya/ sa rlung log nas bad kan rgyas shing lus lci ba dang*/ lhen skran la sogs pa byung na/ dmigs pa rang gi 'dom gang tsam gyi 'og tu/ sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi pa/ 'dom gang tsam zhig gsal bar bsgoms te/ rang gi lus kyi nad pa las gyur pa thams cad yi ge laṃ gyi rnam par 'dus nas gshang lam nas 'thon te sa'i dkyil 'khor la thim par bsam/ rlung sbyor steng du sa rlung bzung zhing*/ 'og rlung yar 'phar rtsa nas bzung la/ mar sdeb tsa na lhod btang la/ tshang ra brdab pa'i stobs kyis 'og gi dkyil 'khor de nyid phrig phrig yo ba la sems bzung nas/ rlung sbyor 'khrul 'khor dmigs pa gsum char dus gcig la byas pas sel lo// chu rlung gi nang byung nas/ grang rlung dang dmu chu la sogs pa la/ 'og tu chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar la zlum pa gsal gdab/ grang ba'i nad thams cad baṃ gyi rnam par bsdus nas bshang lam nas thon (556)te/ chu'i dkyil 'khor la thim par bsgom/ rlung bzung la gong bzhin brdeb bo// me'i nad byung nas tsha spos dang tsha bshal la sogs pa la/ 'og tu me'i dkyil 'khor gsal gdab/ tshad nad thams cad yi ge raṃ gyi rnam par bsdus nas/ bshang lam nas byung ste me la thim pas/ me rlung bzung ste gong bzhin brdeg /rlung gi nad byung nas grang rlung gis stod sbos pa la sogs byung na/ 'og tu rlung gi dkyil 'khor gsal gdab/ rlung nad thams cad yi ge yaṃ gyi rnam par bsdus nas/ 'og sgo nas bud de gdan la thim par bsam zhing*/ rlung gi rlung bzung ba sngar bzhin bsdebs so// de yis ma sgrol na/ dgra dang sprad de/ sa dgra rlung yin pas/ sa'i nad la 'og tu sa'i dkyil 'khor gsal gdab/

steng du rlung gi rlung bzung pas/ sa las gyur pa'i nad thams cad gtor zhing dbus nas gong bzhin dkyil 'khor rab tu g.yo ba la dmigs shing brdabs pas/ lhag ro rnams yi ge laṃ gyi rnam par bsdus nas 'og sgo nas 'thon te/ 'og gi dkyil 'khor la thim pas rlung gis gtor zhing dbus nas dngos med du song bar bsam zhing*/ mthar lus ngag yid gsum kyang rlung la thim la/ rnam par mi rtog pa la bzhag go /rlung gi nad las/ rlung dgra sa yin pas/ 'og tu sa'i dkyil 'khor gsal gdab/ steng du sa rlung bzung pas rlung las gyur pa'i nad thams cad mnan nas/ g.yo ba med par bsam zhing*/ gong bzhin brdabs pas/ lhag ro rnams yaṃ gyi rnam par bton te/ 'og gi dkyil 'khor la bstim zhing*/ mthar lus ngag yid gsum yang*/ 'og gi dkyil 'khor (557)la thim par bsam/ grang ba'i nad la/ chu dgra me yin pas 'og tu me'i dkyil bsam ste/ me rlung bzung zhing brdabs pas/ lhag ro rnams baṃ gyi rnam par bton te/ 'og tu dkyil 'khor la bstim zhing*/ mthar lus ngag yid gsum yang dkyil 'khor la thim par bsam mo// tshad nad la me dgra chu yin pas 'og tu chu'i dkyil 'khor bsgom/ chu rlung bzung zhing brdabs pas lhag ro rnams raṃ gyi rnam par bton te/ 'og tu chu'i dkyil 'khor la bstim zhing*/ mthar lus ngag yid gsum yang dkyil 'khor la thim par bsam mo// spyi khyab tsam du nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor gsal btab nas/ nam mkha'i rlung bzung bas nam mkha' la snod bcud thams cad bstim par/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhag /des rlung dbu mar tshud pa yin gsung*// thung ngu rlung bzung ba'i skabs 'dir thun mtshams sam/ thams cad du yang 'og gi skyil krung drag tu bsgom pa yin gsungs/ grang rlung gis bskyed pa'i nad thad kar dbyung ba ni/ thad ka'i gzer zug drod dang bral ba rnams// rang rang gnas sam bskyed pa'i rtsa sgo nas// zug ngu de ni thad kar dbyung bar bya// zhes pas/

thad ka'i gzer zug ni/ lus kyi gang dang gang byung ba'i zug go /drod dang bral ba ni gnyan tshad la sogs pa dang bral ba'o// rang rang gi gnas ni nad kyi steng dang*/ des mi thon na/ nad de nyid skyes pa'i rtsa sgo shes par byas nas 'don pa'o// sgo dgu'i rgyu ba nang du bsdus pa las// khro bo'i gzugs kyis rang gnas bde bar byed/ (558)gyad kyi stobs kyis sgra gcan las su rung*/ de yi tshe na dgang zhing rab tu 'phang*// zhes pas sgo dgu ni/ kha dang mig la sogs pa'o// de'i rgyu ba ni rlung ngo*// nad ni dbu ma'i 'o// bsdud pa ni rlung dang sems nyid do// khro bo'i gzugs ni rdo rje gtsug tor gyi lta stangs dang ldan pa'o// rab gnas ni tshangs pa'i bu ga'o// rang gnas bde bar byed pa ni/ rtsol ba med par 'pho bar 'gyur zhes pa'o// gyad kyi stobs ni/ shin tu drag de'i shugs chen pos/ g.yas g.yon gyi rlung 'gog pa'o// sgra gcan las su rung ba ni/ g.yas gnyis kyi rtsa rlung bsdams pas/ de'i tshe na dgang zhing ni/ steng 'og bar gyi rlung 'gags pa'o// rab tu 'phang ba ni/ rnam shes srog rlung dang bcas pa/ gtsug tor gyi sgo nas dag pa'i gnas su 'phen pa'o// bdag po gsum gsum rlung sems las su rung*// gling bzhi dang ni rab tu gang la yang*// nyi zla'i rgyu ba 'gag par gyur pa'i tshe// de yi tshe na 'byung ba 'khrugs par 'gyur// zhes pa'o// rtsa ba'i bdag po dbu ma'i rtsa// rlung gi bdag po dbu ma'i rlung*// thig le'i bdag po dbu ma'i thig le ste// de nyid brtan pas rlung sems las su rung zhing*// sgo gsum dag par byed pa bsnyen sgrub gsum gyis// rtsa rlung thig le gsum sbyangs pas// bde ba chen po'i ye shes mngon du byed ces pa dang*/ gling bzhi ni/ zla ba dang ni nyi ma'i rtsa dang*/ dri chen dang dri chu 'bab ba'i rtsa dang*/ ri rab na dbu ma'i rtsa yin no// nyi zla'i rgyu ba ni g.yon g.yas kyi rlung ngo*// 'gags pa ni dbu mar (559)'jug pa'o// yang na/

gling bzhi lta bu yan lag gi rlung ngo*// ri rab lta bu rtsa ba'i rlung dkyil 'khor la thim nas dbu mar 'jug pas/ de'i tshe na 'byung ba 'khrugs pa ni/ dngas snyigs ma byed na 'byed par 'dod pa dang*/ rlung sems dbu mar 'dod pa rnams la 'byung ba 'khrugs pa ste/ dper na me dang chu 'thabs pa'i tshe rlangs pa 'ong ba'am/ slan dang nad 'thabs pa la na zug 'byung ba'am/ 'byung ba tsha grangs 'thabs pa la 'brug gi sgra la sogs pa 'byung ba dang 'dra ste/ rje btsun mi la yab sras la byung ba lta ba'i mthong snang sna tshogs dang*/ nyams kyi mtho dman sna tshogs 'byung ba ste/ de'i dus su/ rtsa la ma dga' mor 'byongs/ thig le las su rung*/ rlung sems gang 'dod du 'drongs pa ste/ de'i dus su yang*/ rlung dang thig le'i 'du 'phrod kyis/ yon tan skyon du song pas tshe thung ba/ rlung rtsa gnas su khrims kyang rtsigs ma sel ma nus pas/ nad du ma'i rgyur 'gro ba dang*/ mthong snang khyad par can rnams nyams myong phyogs re la zhen pas/ bogs 'don mi shes pa 'byung ba srid pas 'di'i dus su nyams myong can gyi bla ma dang*/ rang gi yang snying rus dang*/ brtson 'grus dang shes rab kyis yon tan mthar phyin par byed dgos pa yin gsungs/ nad dbyug pas 'don pa la/ grang ba'i phyogs ni stobs kyis sbyor bas sel// zhes pas/ stobs kyi sbyor ba ni dbyug pa dang 'khrul 'khor yin la/ dbyug pa'i man ngag logs su shes par bya'o// nad 'khrul 'khor gyis (560)'don pa ni/ mgo na ba la rlung bzung nas g.yas g.yon dang mdun rgyab tu bskor zhing*/ sna nas rlung drag tu dbyung*/ rlung thur du dbab/ mig mi gsal na/ lag rgya bcas te lta gzur la phul lo// lag pa na ba'am mi bde na/ g.yas g.yon du bskor zhing sprug /mchin pa na na/ rkang pa skyil krung bca'/ lag pa gnyis rdo rje khu tshur byas la/ pus mgo thad ka nas yar 'degs pa bzhin bteg bteg bya/

ma zhu pa'am skran la skyil krung gi pus mo la lag pas 'jus te pho ba g.yas g.yon du bskor/ de'i rjes la 'khru bar 'dod na/ lus gnad tsog pu byas/ lag pa gnyis kyi bar lhu la 'jug pa'i gru khugs su pus mo bcug ste/ pus mo gnyis re mos su bskul bas 'khru bar 'gyur ro// smad la drod med pa dang*/ grang ba'i nad la/ 'og sgo 'byed 'dzum dang bsdeb pa mang du bya/ rims nad zlog pa la/ langs la rkang pa gnyis gshibs/ lag pa bsnol mar dpung pa la 'jus/ rlung thub tshang du bzung zhing lta stangs drag tu bcun/ rlung mi thub pa dang*/ ltag pa je dgye je dgye btang*/ de ltar byas pas dkrug thom pa cig yong*/ de nas rlung drag tu 'bud/ mgo la thal bcag brdeg /des thub po/ dbugs sdud mi shes pa byung na lag pa gnyis sbrags te mi gcig gis khur nas ro stod la khu tshur gyis bzung*/ ha drag tu 'don/ rlung 'og tu bcing*/ lus kyi gzhogs zha ba'am skams na/ rtsa ro brkyang gnyis gsal gdab/ gang zha ba ngos kyi phyogs su rtsa nang du thig le tshes brgyad kyi zla ba lta bu yar rgyu mar rgyu byed par (561)bsam/ lus skrangs ba dang sbo ba la/ dri chus bkrus la mar nag gi sku mnye bya/ sha skyi'i bar du rlung zhugs na/ ras chur bcug pas bkab la me la zug tshang du 'dug /chu rlung rengs pa la/ phyid pa chur bcug pas dril la me la zug tshang du bdug /mar nag dang tsha ba gsum gyi sku mnye bya/ me rlung btsan thabs su bzung*/ skyug par 'dod na// lag pa dang pus mo sa la gzugs/ mchan 'og tu ber ka cig la nang cha sko ro ro yong bar bsam/ ngag tu ha ring por 'don/ dran med du 'gro ba'am brgyal ba lta bu 'ong na/ 'ong ba'i ltas byung ma thag 'og sgo bsdam/ mgrin pa dgug /ol mdud mnan/ mig g.yas g.yon gyi dngos po la phar hrig tshur hrig blta zhing*/ gzungs su bzung*/ des ma sel na/ grogs kyi phye gsur gyis bdug

/rkang mthil khu tshur gyis brdung*/ mgo bo ltag pa nas mdun du dgug /mgo la thal bcag dal bus brdeg /des kyang ma sol na rdo rje la g.ya' dgugs so// drod la nges par bsil pa'i chu rgyun dbab// ces pa ni/ lte 'og sor bzhi'i mtshams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la sems bzung zhing*/ chu rlung so bar nas sir sgra dang bcas nas drangs pas/ zla ba de rgya je che la song nas/ mthar snang ba thams cad zla bar song bar bsam/ gtong dus sna nas btang nas lus khrang hril 'gro'o// rang sa'i rgyun lam rab tu 'gags pa la// 'phang zhing brdung ba'i sbyor bas sel bar 'gyur// zhes pas/ rang sa'i rgyun lam ni srog dang thur sel gyi (562)lam mo// rab tu 'gags pa ni rang dbang med par 'khyil bas 'gags pa'o// 'phang zhing brdung ba ni/ ha dang dbyug pa'i man ngag gis sel lo// de'ang sgom sgrub 'jur rtags pa'am/ mya ngan drag po la sogs pa'i rkyen ci rigs pa'i/ rlung nang du 'dus nas srog 'dzin 'thums te/ bya snyi la zin pa bzhin du/ ci byas kyang mi bde/ snying mi dga' ba la sogs pa'i sems las kyis mdun rgyab tu na zhing 'gags pa dang*/ spyil bu sgo med du dud pa btang ba bzhin du/ log pa'i gnas su rlung 'thums par/ shugs ring 'don zhing*/ dbugs tshad du drangs du mi 'dod pa dang*/ snying gzer la sogs pa'i nad la/ rlung 'thums kyi sgo bcag pa lta bu'am/ gnas nas byung ba la/ ltag 'then la sogs pa'i gegs sel rnams dgos pas ltag 'then zhu pa'i maṇ+ḍal la gser zho re med par mi ster pa'i bka' rgya yod do// brdud pa'i sbyor ba ni/ dbyug pa dang khu tshur gyis rgyab gzhung la sogs pa'i gnas su ci rigs par brdungs pas sel lo// gang du bcud pa de ni stobs kyi rlung*// dgang zhing bcud la dbyung pas rab tu sel// zhes pa ste/ gang na sar 'khrul 'khor gyis bcud pa'i sa de na/ nad dang 'dzom pa'i stobs kyis rlung yod pas/

rlung gis dgang zhing 'khrul 'khor gyis bcun la/ khrol tshags kyi bu ga lta bu na phar la nad thon par bsgoms pas sel bar 'gyur ro// de la 'dir gling bzhi bcud la bor ba la gsum ste/ phyi gling bzhi bcud la bor ba ni/ dran med du 'gro ba'am/ rlung stod du 'tshangs pa'am/ shes pa (563)'phyo sangs khyer ba 'am/ mgo dang ro stod na ba dang*/ rkang pa gong sor song dgos pa lta bu la/ rkang pa gnyis gshibs/ lag pa gnyis pus mo gnyis la 'jus/ rked pa dang gru mo gnyis bsrang*/ tshang ra khru gang man chad du sa la phebs tshad du dbab pa/ srin zhal drag tu bsdam/ shes pa rang sor bzhag cing glod nas 'og tu me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum la sems bzung*/ rlung mi bzung bar bzhag /nang gling gzhi bcud la bor ba ni/ gan rkyal du byas la/ rkang pa brkyang*/ rkang pa'i rgyu ma bskum/ rting pa gnyis dang brang rwe mos su phyir 'phul/ shes pa rkang thil la bcun zhing*/ rlung mi bzung bar rang sor bzhag /bar gling bzhi bcud la bor ba ni/ gan rkyal du nyal la/ rkang pa gnyis kyi rgyu ma lag pas bzung ste/ lag pas yar 'then rkang pas mar 'phul te/ lus thang sha bcad nas rlung mi bzung bar rang sor bzhag go /de ltar mi nus na/ sbyang thag bya ste/ de la 'jus nas gling bzhi bcud la bor bar bya'o// grang nad kyis gshang sgo lug pa'am skrangs pa'am/ 'bu srin gyis za ba la/ rkang lag bzhi sa la btsugs/ gru mos pus mo phar la 'bul/ pus mos gru mo tshur bsdam mo// de ltar gegs sel gyi 'bras bu ni/ lus kyi nad 'joms stobs dang bde ba rgyas/ de lta bu'i dmigs pa dang 'khru 'khor la sogs pa'i gegs sel gyi gnad rnams zin par byas la/ lus kyi nad rnams bcom zhing bde ba rgyas te/ dwangs ma dang stobs su 'gyur ro// gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu gsungs pa ni/ (564)rtsa sbyangs pas ni lus kyi dri ma dag /rlung sbyangs pas ni ngag gi dri ma dag

/'dzag med thob pas yid kyis bag chags bcom// ces pas/ 'dir sbyang bar bya ba rtsa ā wa dhū ti/ sbyong byed bsnyen pa'i yan lag gis sbyangs pas lus kyi dri ma dag ste/ mngon par shes pa lnga dang sprul pa'i sku thob par byed do// yang sbyang gzhi ngag dang rlung*/ sbyong byed gsung rdo rjes sbyangs pas ngag gi dri ma dag nas 'pho ba'i bag chags bcom ste/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thob par byed do// de bzhin du sbyang gzhi yid dang thig le 'pho ba'i bag chags te/ sbyong byed sgrub pa chen po thugs rdo rjes sbyongs pas/ yid kyi bag chags bcom ste/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba dang chos kyi sku thob par byed do// de ltar sku gsum dbyer med ngo bo nyid kyi sku ste/ rdo rje gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub kyis sku bzhi mngon du byed pa yin gsungs/ sgrub pa chen po'i yon tan bstan pa na/ 'khor lo'i mdud pa dga' bzhi'i 'gros kyis bshig /ces pas/ 'khor lo zhes pa ni/ dpral ba dang*/ mgrin pa dang*/ snying ka dang*/ lte ba rnams kyi 'khor lo ste de tsho'i mdud pa rnams/ sgrub pa chen po'i rnal 'byor bsgoms pas dga' bzhi'i 'gros rim pa can dang rim min gnyis kyi stobs kyis bshig pas/ sad pa'i gnas skabs dang*/ rmi lam gyi gnas skabs dang*/ gnyid 'thug po'i gnas skabs dang*/ snyoms 'jug gi gnas skabs kyis sgrib pa las grol bar byed do// sgrib pa de rnams dang bral bas 'khor ba'i rtsa ba ma rig pa spong ba ste/ ma rig sems ni brgyal ba log (565)pas dwangs// chags bral nyams pas zhe sdang zad pa'i sems// chags pa dag pas bde ba chen por grol// zhes pa'i ma rig pa ni/ sems can rnams kyi 'dod chags kyi bag chags thog med dus nas goms pa de'i/ nga rgyal ba ni byang chub kyi sems phyi rol du lhung pa las/ zhe sdang gi sems kyi rjes la gti mug gi sems skye ste/

byang chub kyi sems rdo rje nor bur brtan par byas pa la nyid ni brgyal ba log par byas pa'o// brgyal ba log ste mi 'gyur pa'i bde ba chen po'i sems kyis/ ma rig pa'i sems 'dod chags 'khor ba'i bag chags ngan pa dwangs te zad par byed pa'o// chags bral zhes pa ni byang chub kyi sems phyi rol du lhung pa las/ bde ba'i drod dang bral bas te/ byang sems nor bur brtan pa las/ chags bral nyams pa ste/ bde ba dang bral ba med ces pa'o// zhe sdang ni thig le 'phos pa'i tshe na/ zhe sdang gi sems su 'gyur zhing*/ byang chub kyi sems 'phos pa med pa las/ zhe sdang zad pa'i sems su 'gyur ba'o// zhe sdang zad pa nyid kyis zhe sdang gi rang bzhin gti mug tu zad de 'dod chags 'khor pa'i bag chag ma rig pa dag pas/ 'gyur pa'i bde ba la chags pa dag ste/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen por grol ba'o// ma rig pa'i yan lag rten 'brel bcu gnyis 'gags pas 'bras bu thob tshul ni/ nor bu nas ni gtsug tor 'khor lo'i bar// brgya phrag bco brgyad las kyi rlung 'gags pas// rim pa des nis re thob par 'gyur// zhes pas/ rjes dran dang ting nge 'dzin gyi rnal 'byor gyis (566)srog la sogs pa'i rlung bcu 'gags pa las/ rdo rje nor bu nas gtsug tor gyi 'khor lo'i bar/ byang chub kyi sems kyi thig le rim pa bzhin du brten par 'gyur ro// brgya phrag bco brgyad ni/ zla ba dang*/ nyi ma dang*/ sgra gcan gsum gyi rtsa la rlung rgyu pa'i rtsal dus sbyor gcig gi grangs so// las kyi rlung zhes pa ni/ rlung bcu po thams cad kyis rang rang gi las byed pa'o// 'gags pa zhes pa ni/ rim pa bzhin du sgrib pa med par bya'o// de yang 'khor lo drug rnams su/ dus sbyor gnyis gnyis kyi rlung 'gags pa las/ sa gnyis gnyis thob par 'gyur ro// de yang sngags dang mtshan nyid kyi khyad par gyi ming gi rnam grangs ni/

sa dang po rab tu dga' ba dang*/ gnyis pa dri ma med pa dang*/ gnas dang nye ba'i gnas zhes pa dang*/ gsum pa 'od byed pa dang*/ bzhi pa 'od 'phro ba dang*/ zhing dang nye ba'i zhing zhes pa dang*/ sa lnga pa sbyang dka' ba dang*/ drug pa mngon du gyur pa dang*/ tshan rdo dang nye ba'i tshan rdo dang zhes dang*/ sa bdun pa ring du song ba dang*/ brgyad pa mi g.yo ba dang*/ 'dus pa dang nye ba'i 'dus pa dang zhes dang*/ sa dgu pa legs pa'i blo gros dang*/ bcu pa chos kyi sprin dang*/ dur khrod dang nye ba'i dur khrod ces dang*/ sa bcu gcig kun tu 'ong dang*/ bcu gnyis ma chags pad+ma'i spyan dang*/ 'thungs gcod dang nye ba'i 'thungs gcod zhes pa rnams so// de rnams dang dus mtshungs par rten 'brel bcu gnyis rim pa bzhin du 'gag pa ste/ rdo rje nor bur dus sbyor gcig gi rlung 'gags pas rten 'brel dang po 'gag cing*/ (567)byang chub kyi sems rdo rje nor bu las gyen du log pas/ sa dang po thob ste 'jig rten gyi khams gcig gi snod bcud mthong zhing*/ don byed nus pa'o// de nas byang chub kyi sems brtan pa de gsang ba'i 'khor lor log cing 'chings pas/ rten 'brel gnyis pa dag /dus sbyor gnyis kyi rlung 'gags pas/ sa gnyis pa thob ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams gnyis kyi don byed nus so// de nas dus sbyor gyi rlung 'gags pa las/ byang sems lte ba'i 'khor lor 'chings pas/ rten 'brel gsum dag sa gsum thob ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams gsum gyi don byed nus so// de nas dus sbyor bzhi'i rlung 'gags pa las/ byang sems lte ba'i 'khor lor 'chings pas/ rten 'brel bzhi pa dag /sa bzhi pa thob ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams brgyad kyi don mthong zhing sprul pa 'gyed nus so// de nas dus sbyor lnga'i rlung 'gags pa las/ byang sems lte ba nas snying ga'i bar du 'chings pas/ rten 'brel lnga pa dag sa lnga pa thob ste/

'jig rten gyi khams bcu drug gi don mthong zhing sprul pa 'gyed nus so// de nas dus sbyor drug gi rlung 'gags pas/ byang sems snying ga'i 'khor lo 'chings pas/ rten 'brel drug pa dag /sa drug pa thob ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi don mthong zhing sprul pa 'gyed nus so// de nas dus sbyor bdun gyi rlung 'gags pas/ byang sems mgrin pa'i bar du 'chings pas/ rten 'brel bdun pa dag /sa bdun pa thob ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams drug cu rtsa bzhi'i don byed nus so// de nas dus sbyor brgyad kyi rlung 'gags pas// (568)byang sems mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lor 'chings pas/ rten 'brel brgyad pa dag /sa brgyad pa thob/ 'jig rten gyi khams brgya nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi don byed nus so// de nas dus sbyor dgu'i rlung 'gags pa las/ byang sems mgrin pa nas dpral ba'i bar du 'chings pas/ rten 'brel dgu pa dag /sa dgu pa thob ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa drug gi don byed nus so// de nas dus sbyor bcu'i rlung 'gags pa las/ byang sems dpral ba bde chen gyi 'khor lo 'chings pas/ rten 'brel bcu pa dag /sa bcu pa thob ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams lnga brgya bcu gnyis kyi don byed par nus so// de ltar dus sbyor bcu gcig gi rlung 'gags byang sems gtsug tor gyi bar du 'chings pas/ rten 'brel bcu gcig bdag /sa bcu gcig pa thob/ 'jig rten gyi khams stong nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i don byed par nus so// de nas dus sbyor bcu gnyis kyi rlung nyi khri chig stong drug brgya po thams cad 'gags te/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis pa rga shi 'dag cing*/ spyan lnga dang mngon par shes pa drug thob/ gtsug tor 'khor lo'i steng du thig le byang chub kyi sems yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bcu gnyis sa thob ste/
